# D8 authority-transfer crosswalk — temporary review artifact

**D8.1 / WR-002 / pending_review.** Accepted source revision: `213715ca7493c49a4f272558670eb0a297bae9a0` (D7 accepted main). This artifact inventories; it does not transfer authority, approve a correction, retire a source, complete D8 or release V1. MASTER_SPEC and ROADMAP remain governing. Remove this temporary artifact only during separately approved D8.3 after transfer acceptance. There is no new permanent master specification.

Scope follows [the accepted routing map](documentation-consolidation.md#master_spec-and-roadmap-transfer), [standing rules](../../AGENTS.md) and [contributor review](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#review-and-completion). The source map below preserves exact paragraphs, clauses, revisions and evidence, including normative material inside COMPLETE/PASS headings. No governing or historical source changes in D8.1.

## How to review

The machine-readable register at the end is the detailed crosswalk, not an executable policy. Search a stable ID such as `D8-MS-L0115-C01`, source line or assessment name. A source group carries document/revision/section/paragraph/line range and exact normalized-text hash. Each clause carries an exact source substring and character span, explicit classification/status and named assessment. Its assessment supplies **primary destination, existing coverage, additional text, acceptance/constraints/dependencies, evidence and backlog**. Assessment conflict analysis is subsystem context, not an inherited clause-level conflict. Named clause overrides determine the effective classification/status/transfer and exact conflict relationship. These fields are deliberately factored to avoid copying the same acceptance contract hundreds of times; resolve them together for each clause. Historical findings have exact line spans, excerpt hashes and their own necessary transfer text.

Source clauses are split at independently reviewable sentence/semicolon boundaries; lists within a single requirement retain their entire stated condition. Context-only structural headings are inventoried separately, never counted as requirements. Milestone headings containing substantive PASS or post-V1 constraints receive clause records. Counts below are **traceable review clauses**, including historical dispositions, not a claim that a syntactic parser proves semantic completeness. Reviewers must verify whether another split/destination is needed. Tests prove coverage of the declared text groups and exact spans, not scientific validity, implementation correctness or approval. No completion percentage is inferred.

Every record starts `pending_review`. `current_implemented_contract` means source/test-supported behavior within the stated assessment scope, not full empirical verification. `approved_unimplemented_requirement` can be partially delivered; the remaining exact quoted duty survives. Conditional design approval does not authorize its implementation. Proposed research methods are not approved defaults. Historical-only statements require the cited accepted successor/rationale; code divergence alone never supersedes a requirement. Evidence files are inspected support and existing regression references, **not newly executed numerical/live tests** in D8.1.

The register declares column names for compact row arrays. Source document is `MS` = MASTER_SPEC or `RM` = ROADMAP, and start line is encoded in the group ID; every group uses the accepted revision above. Section titles resolve through `section_titles`. A clause's group is its ID without `D8-` and the final `-Cnn`. Null row classification/status overrides inherit the named assessment, unless a named `clause_overrides` entry supplies a narrower field; all reviewer statuses inherit the register's `pending_review` (historical records also state it explicitly). The one-row-per-clause encoding avoids megabytes of repeated field labels; it does not omit any resolved crosswalk field.

## Review summary

Inventoried **all 407 blank-separated source groups** in MASTER_SPEC and ROADMAP, including preambles, all numbered sections, detailed M0–M8 gates, accepted corrections, LW addenda, appendix and repeated M2.6 tail. 314 substantive groups produce **2093 individual review clauses**; 93 structural groups are context only. **33 unique historical-finding records** cover all eleven required residual documents, including both compatibility and archive copies. Duplicate source obligations retain separate source IDs, not inferred equivalence.

| Classification | Governing clauses | Historical findings |
|---|---:|---:|
| `current_implemented_contract` | 881 | 5 |
| `approved_unimplemented_requirement` | 63 | 1 |
| `conditional_approval_or_constraint` | 986 | 18 |
| `proposal_not_yet_authorized` | 32 | 6 |
| `unresolved_conflict_or_decision` | 3 | 0 |
| `historical_or_superseded` | 128 | 3 |

Coverage at destinations is recorded per assessment below. Implemented restrictions often already exist; scientific promotion, broader outputs/diagnostics/query, checkpoint retention and release evidence still need exact BACKLOG transfer. There is no blanket 'already implemented' certificate. C01–C19 mix accepted successors, binding implementation/evidence gaps and genuine open scope/acceptance decisions. Their clause-level relationships below replace subsystem-wide decision inheritance; no defect or release gate is waived. No source section is omitted from the inventory; sources with unresolved **substance** include MASTER 1.3, 2.3, 4.2–4.7, 5.2–5.4, 6.2–6.3, 7, 9.3–9.5, 10.1–10.5 and M8/follow-ups. ROADMAP's expanded M2/M3/M5/M8/LW gates remain individually traced even where MASTER has similar text.

There are 79 distinct destination assessments. Their existing-coverage statements identify actual interfaces/limitations; additional-transfer fields are D8.2 proposals, not text already inserted into authorities. Existing BACKLOG IDs remain the homes for outstanding work. No new implementation task is approved by a missing-transfer finding.

| Transfer disposition (requirements text, not feature completion) | Governing clauses |
|---|---:|
| `already_covered` | 1840 |
| `historical_only` | 128 |
| `requires_backlog_expansion` | 47 |
| `requires_decision` | 11 |
| `requires_domain_transfer` | 67 |

`already_covered` means the destination contains the stated contract/limitation, even when the implementation/evidence remains partial. `requires_decision` now marks only a clause-specific outstanding scope/authority/control decision; accepted-successor confirmation alone does not require a new decision; a complete existing limitation description does not waive the governing duty. Other rows explicitly identify additional permanent text or BACKLOG detail. These are review classifications, not deletion certificates or implementation-completion percentages.

## Proposed D8.2 transfer scope

After independent crosswalk acceptance, port only missing enduring text into the primary owners above and expand exact existing BACKLOG details. In particular: WR-019 scientific protocol/bias/sparse/support conditions; WR-008/021 proxy/diagnostic/representative resource criteria; WR-017/021 compound query/export and active-versus-durable history decision; WR-021 build provenance, complete output distributions, checkpoint lifecycle, refresh failure boundaries and all release signoffs. Preserve WR-018, WR-023/024/025/026 verbatim in meaning and conditional evidence gates. Do not add an algorithm, numerical method or public DTO while transferring a requirement.

Review every required field after profile resolution: exact destination text versus accepted quotation; missing coverage cannot be replaced by symbol existence. Resolve or retain explicit conflicts with approval/delivery separated. Update source-linked documentation tests without weakening functional/oracle/golden checks. Only then propose the explicit authority-link switch in AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING/README/overview/BACKLOG; no source deletion before accepted transfer. Where a reviewer declines a proposed successor, retain the governing source until an approved replacement exists.

## Proposed D8.3 retirement scope

After D8.2 authority transfer is independently accepted and each affected conflict/consumer is dispositioned, separately review deletion of MASTER_SPEC, ROADMAP, the eleven residual historical sources inventoried here, the accepted temporary consolidation plan and this temporary crosswalk. This is proposed scope, not deletion authorization in D8.1. Re-scan literal/code/test/Markdown/anchor references and actual evidence consumers at that revision; hold any unresolved source. Keep required benchmarks/oracles/artifacts/example plans and all private data untouched. Replace only obsolete documentation structure assertions with owning-contract checks; no blanket removal of source/evidence tests. Git/PRs preserve ordinary delivery history. No compatibility stub or external-bookmark guarantee is presumed; disclose unverified external consumers. D8 completion/WR-002 closure requires independent review, and neither implies release.

## Source baseline and historical extraction

## Verification boundary

D8.1 verification is offline documentation/source-reference consistency, privacy/security and existing release-marker/M0 compatibility checks. It does not execute live ESPN, user databases, process recovery, numerical/model changes, dependency upgrades or performance experiments. Exact commands/results belong in this PR; no historical suite total here is a new run. The register tests preserve all sources and verify unique IDs, full declared group coverage/exact clause spans, classifications/statuses, destination anchors/backlog IDs, evidence paths, source hashes and pending reviewer decisions. They cannot prove semantic completeness or satisfy scientific/release acceptance.

## Clause-level classification follow-up

PR #131 review baseline: `f7e347e04618edf2ad05f85ac48f9b783f69920e`. This follow-up audits every clause attached to the 19 conflict/successor groups (847 distinct clauses across 27 shared assessments), plus historical overrides in other assessments. The original 79 assessments, all 407 source groups, 2,093 IDs/text spans, 33 historical findings, source hashes/revision, destination owners and evidence references are unchanged. No new authority decision, production correction, feature or release is approved.

**Resolution is field-by-field:** named `clause_overrides` wins over existing row classification/status overrides, which win over assessment defaults. Transfer defaults to the assessment only when no clause override is present. Conflict prose on an assessment is contextual: effective `conflict_references` comes only from a clause's explicit relationship list (empty means unaffected). Reviewer disposition remains `pending_review` at every layer. A pending crosswalk review does not revoke an already accepted technical requirement or successor.

Each override has a `reason_ref` into `clause_override_reasons` to avoid repeating identical explanations. These reason records are not classification defaults: every changed field and relationship stays explicit on the clause. Unchanged audited clauses remain in `conflict_audit` without empty overrides.

`accepted_supersession` confirms an existing accepted correction, never demands fresh engineering approval by itself. `implementation_gap` or `remaining_evidence_gate` preserves a binding duty with an uncorrected/unevidenced implementation; `already_covered` only says the duty and gap have a documented home. `open_scope_decision` and `authority_transfer_gate` identify actual outstanding decisions; `independent_acceptance_gate` preserves unfinished P0/configuration/release signoff without reopening unrelated accepted controls. `reference_contract` marks the independently tested oracle's behavior, not a claim the production defect is fixed.

**703 clauses change at least one effective classification, implementation status or transfer disposition**. 3 change only implementation status; conflict-reference/rationale-only edits are not included in that count. The baseline comparison resolves actual f7e347e row/assessment fields; its old summary special-cased historical transfers without encoding per-clause overrides. The new summary is calculated from the same effective fields used by validation, with no hidden historical shortcut. Exact changed IDs and joint classification/transfer transitions are in `followup_change_summary`.

WR-023 exact arithmetic, WR-024 incomplete-value production selection, WR-025 repeated paired inference, WR-026 cleanup, scientific authentication, richer outputs/query, checkpoint expiry and independent release acceptance remain open. Their exact affected obligations retain explicit references/statuses and independent regression guards; an override cannot convert them to historical/proposed/fully implemented or discard their remaining gate. Conversely no-voluntary-upgrade, immediate timing, matched-prefix allocation and accepted engine-only composition do not inherit an unrelated subsystem conflict. This is classification/traceability refinement, not D8.2 transfer or deletion approval.

  "clauses": [
    ["D8-MS-L0003-C01",0,226,"*Version: canonical schema v4 / SQLite schema v1 / historical research dataset schema v2 / application API schema 1.0 | 10 November 2026 | Status: M0–M8.3 and associated consolidation checkpoints are **COMPLETE AND ACCEPTED**;","history",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0003-C02",227,316,"M8.4 and LW1 are implemented pending independent review and V1 is not declared released.*","history",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0005-C01",0,100,"This is the authoritative specification for approved analytical requirements and modeling contracts.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0005-C02",101,197,"It synthesizes the 76 agreed design decisions into a coherent description of the intended model;","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0005-C03",198,263,"the older decision log is archived for historical reference only.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0005-C04",264,384,"Status labels and evidence statements distinguish implemented and verified behavior from planned or unresolved behavior;","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0005-C05",385,493,"a prospective requirement is not evidence that an algorithm or ESPN field has been implemented or confirmed.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C01",0,266,"R2.0 documentation governance: \u005bBACKLOG.md\u005d(BACKLOG.md) is authoritative for outstanding development work and \u005bstatus.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/6f12f5fe5be49112546bf035b6d885b645898a86/docs/status.md) for current capability summaries.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C02",267,347,"\u005bCONTRIBUTING.md\u005d(../CONTRIBUTING.md) defines the reviewed branch/fork workflow.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C03",348,512,"The delivery sections here and \u005bROADMAP.md\u005d(ROADMAP.md) preserve historical milestones, dependencies and acceptance evidence rather than a second active work queue.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C04",513,599,"No analytical requirement or applicable gate is removed by this navigation transition;","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C05",600,671,"gate extraction/reconciliation remains explicit pending work in WR-002.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0007-C06",672,762,"Summaries or backlog priorities cannot override this specification or approve a new model.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0013-C01",0,242,"Use ESPN’s player-specific future weekly fantasy point projections, real league rules, and the current league state to estimate the distribution of season outcomes and determine which roster actions maximize expected championship probability.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0013-C02",243,420,"The engine evaluates every manager, not just the user, and supports interpretation of effects on playoff qualification, seeding, future waiver competition, and final placements.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0013-C03",421,542,"Secondary decision objectives may be supported later, but championship probability is the default optimization objective.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0015-C01",0,101,"The engine is not initially intended to outperform ESPN’s forecasts of individual player mean points.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0015-C02",102,312,"Rather, it converts their projections into realistic uncertain seasons, accounts for actual roster constraints and decision consequences, and compares actionable roster changes against the appropriate baseline.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0015-C03",313,356,"ESPN is the sole initial projection source.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0015-C04",357,505,"External inputs may be considered later only if they demonstrate validated incremental value and are approved as part of a versioned official model.","purpose",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C01",0,31,"Build clean-sheet architecture;","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C02",32,134,"the prior Streamlit/ESPN/trade/waiver code is optional reference material and must not dictate design.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C03",135,309,"Deliver an end-to-end, structurally complete system early, with simple provisional methods behind swappable interfaces, then replace individual calculations after validation.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C04",310,377,"Prefer correctness, empirical evidence, reproducibility, and speed;","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C05",378,455,"use configurable assumptions instead of silently inventing unsupported rules.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0019-C06",456,509,"Keep the model independent of its presentation layer.","governance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C01",0,30,"V1 is a local web application.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C02",31,311,"The provisional preferred stack is a React and TypeScript frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, a FastAPI application backend, the accepted Python analytical engine, SQLite for canonical snapshots and appropriately managed application records, and bounded local background execution.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C03",312,378,"The service binds to localhost and has no public deployment in V1.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C04",379,463,"Framework choices remain amendable during M6 research if evidence supports a change.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C05",464,586,"A minimal developer CLI remains useful for diagnostics and reproducibility, but it is not the primary interactive product.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C06",587,722,"The frontend must never independently implement transaction legality, roster completion, Monte Carlo statistics, or analytical ranking.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C07",723,839,"It initially supports one ESPN league while preserving league_id and season keys for future multi-league capability.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0021-C08",840,903,"No hosted service or automated ESPN polling is required for V1.","local",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C01",0,171,"Project-wide fail-fast engineering policy (agreed): Favor explicit invariants, transparent failures, and diagnostic traceability over silently forgiving unexpected states.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C02",172,472,"Do NOT introduce automatic fallback rules, catch-and-continue behavior, guessed tie priority, substitute data, implicit correction of invalid rosters, defaulted missing league rules, or other safety-net logic unless the relevant behavior has been explicitly designed, approved, documented and tested.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C03",473,716,"When an expectation is violated, report a meaningful exception/validation failure with the offending trade step, team/player IDs, snapshot/config values and violated invariant, and do not produce authoritative results from an unverified state.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C04",717,944,"Observed invariants such as 'at most one participant needs a drop for a given two-party trade' must be asserted or checked, NOT achieved by hardcoding codepaths that exclude the unexpected possibility before it can be observed.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C05",945,1033,"Add negative and adversarial tests specifically designed to reveal invariant violations.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C06",1034,1289,"Distinguish supported, intentionally designed alternative algorithms (such as user-provided league settings for fields ESPN does not expose, calibrated statistical pooling, or explicit operational recovery checkpoints) from silent error-masking fallbacks.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C07",1290,1422,"Clearly marked partial Monte Carlo results produced at an approved resource cap are expected behavior, not an error-handling excuse.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C08",1423,1566,"Fail fast on structural/data violations, while allowing only documented normal probabilistic variation and intentionally configurable settings.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0023-C09",1567,1689,"The objective is discoverable bugs and auditable model integrity, not needless crashes or lack of informative diagnostics.","failfast",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C01",0,424,"System-wide exhaustive-search principle (confirmed): Every action/search family—including single trades, multi-transaction chains, standalone waivers, combined trade/waiver moves, streaming, and any future transaction type—must be capable of enumerating ALL candidates within an explicitly defined finite user-selected universe, subject ONLY to real legality/structural feasibility and explicitly approved model constraints.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C02",425,676,"Do not hardcode attractiveness thresholds, positive intermediate V(R), positive counterparty value, minimum expected championship delta, search-rank cutoffs, fixed top-N limits, favored partners, or implicit candidate caps as eligibility requirements.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C03",677,910,"Make narrowing controls independent, explicit and configurable: teams/players, transaction shape, chain length, pickup/drop scope, V(R) screening, counterparty acceptance proxies, numerical budget, and practical resource constraints.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C04",911,1030,"Default heuristics/presets may improve speed but must be independently disableable and must disclose any coverage lost.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C05",1031,1151,"An exhaustive mode bypasses all optional pruning and guarantees full feasible-candidate coverage of the chosen universe;","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C06",1152,1239,"this is distinct from evaluating every candidate to a particular statistical precision.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C07",1240,1419,"If computation or time caps prevent finishing enumeration or Monte Carlo evaluations, mark precise stage coverage, candidates not examined, and incomplete statistical convergence;","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C08",1420,1469,"never silently label a partial search exhaustive.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C09",1470,1559,"Use a shared abstraction across action families to ensure consistent semantics and tests.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0025-C10",1560,1641,"Fail fast on unapproved implicit filtering or unexpected feasibility assumptions.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C01",0,184,"V1 begins only at fully completed fantasy scoring-week boundaries: settled past weeks remain actual, future unstarted weeks are simulated, and partial/live-week forecasts are deferred.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C02",185,234,"Managers choose optimal projected legal starters;","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C03",235,379,"future discretionary trades, speculative waiver upgrades, manager inattention and intentionally suboptimal starters are not modeled in baseline.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C04",380,492,"Only essential future waiver acquisitions are simulated when a required starter slot cannot otherwise be filled.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C05",493,549,"Player performances are conditionally independent in V1;","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C06",550,625,"independent future injury events and game/player correlations are deferred.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0029-C07",626,744,"Results are not claims that actual managers will behave optimally or that injury uncertainty is captured exhaustively.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C01",0,182,"LW1 scoring-state addendum (implemented pending review): schema v4 preserves explicit NFL game-status and current player actual-score observations separately from future projections.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C02",183,394,"Because V1 copies cumulative standings and has no omitted-period reconciliation, automatic start-week detection authorizes only the current explicitly unplayed week at the start of its configured matchup period.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C03",395,518,"The next fully unplayed week is reported independently and cannot authorize skipping a partial or unsettled current period.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C04",519,609,"Final NFL games or player-score records do not prove fantasy-matchup/standings settlement;","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C05",610,677,"actual-record presence, explicit zero, and absence remain distinct.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C06",678,733,"Manual overrides obey the same safe-boundary invariant.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C07",734,849,"Nullable API 1.0 summaries expose current, completed, earliest-unresolved, next-unplayed, and supported boundaries.","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0031-C08",850,1123,"Partial-week outcomes, lineup locks, settlement reconciliation, and actual-plus-simulated combination are deferred to LW2 under \u005bLIVE_WEEK_SCORING.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/7cfb09b4935f3e73bbfdb76e25b1cab102b751c1/docs/LIVE_WEEK_SCORING.md).","whole",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C01",0,111,"LW2.1 partial-week contract addendum (implemented pending review): the accepted engine remains whole-week-only.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C02",112,437,"A future partial-week extension must supply one immutable evidence companion containing a verified standings cutoff, matchup carry-in, observed lineup and player-specific lock determinations, fixed actual components, semantically classified projections, approved conditional remaining components, and source/evidence digests.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C03",438,481,"Completed performance is never resimulated;","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C04",482,504,"missing is never zero;","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C05",505,565,"fixed actuals and matchup carry-in are counted exactly once;","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C06",566,628,"current actions cannot alter locked or already-earned results.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C07",629,726,"Unstarted players may reuse the accepted model only with verified full-game projection semantics.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C08",727,810,"In-progress players require an independently evaluated conditional remaining model;","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C09",811,873,"`projection - actual` and unconditional redraws are forbidden.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C10",874,981,"The existing deterministic coordinator is the extension point, and later weeks retain existing mathematics.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C11",982,1147,"See \u005bLW2_PARTIAL_WEEK_CONTRACT.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/06b408f818d3debd52c6a86793f21dfd697f50f8/docs/LW2_PARTIAL_WEEK_CONTRACT.md).","partial","historical_or_superseded","historical_or_superseded"],
    ["D8-MS-L0033-C12",1148,1251,"LW2.1 does not authorize LW2.2, partial-week Monte Carlo, current-week lineup optimization, or UI work.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0035-C01",0,198,"LW2.2A canonical foundation addendum (implemented pending review): the accepted LW2.1 contract now has a standalone immutable artifact version 1 (`partial_week.py`, `partial_week_serialization.py`).","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0035-C02",199,389,"Snapshot/source identity, schedule membership, observed lineup legality, lock authority, standings cutoff, fixed scores and multiweek carry-in are validated before deterministic composition.","partial",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0035-C03",390,463,"Unresolved evidence remains inspectable but cannot authorize calculation.","partial",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0041-C01",0,362,"LW2.3A performance/consolidation checkpoint (independently accepted; execution baseline `86189da`, checkpoint implementation `d630887`): a separate synthetic benchmark compares ordinary V1 with fully unstarted partial input at 100/500/1,000 paths, repeated sequential and parallel runs, validation/composition/serialization profiling and approximate process RSS.","performance",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0047-C01",0,2,"A.","architecture",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0047-C20",1090,1274,"ResultsAggregator, persistence, and reporting produce cumulative output, uncertainty/diagnostics, temporary recovery checkpoints, indexed active results, and application-ready records.","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0049-C01",0,118,"The dependency direction is frontend → application service/API → accepted Python analytical engine → data/persistence.","architecture",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0049-C03",264,386,"Avoid duplicate persistence systems, speculative cloud infrastructure, and presentation-driven changes to engine behavior.","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0051-C01",0,136,"Component interfaces must be explicit enough to test and replace actual model policies, but not a heavyweight abstract plugin framework.","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0051-C02",137,262,"ESPN IDs, fantasy weeks, eligibility matrices, scenario ownership and snapshot metadata remain consistent across all modules.","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0051-C03",263,323,"Data preparation and reporting are ordinary readable Python;","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0051-C04",324,426,"performance-sensitive simulation internals favor compact arrays, compiled loops and batched execution.","architecture",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0055-C01",0,498,"Explicit data refresh → stage/validate and atomically publish immutable ESPN snapshot → choose existing validated snapshot (with age warning if stale) → select official model and fast/detailed run configuration → evaluate baseline season trajectories → optionally apply a structurally coherent hypothetical roster state or generate feasible candidate moves → rerun on the SAME snapshot using paired shocks → report probability deltas, uncertainty, transaction dynamics and league-wide consequences.","workflow",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0057-C01",0,60,"Simulation execution never silently triggers ESPN retrieval.","workflow",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0057-C02",61,143,"Baseline and scenarios in one comparison must use exactly the same input snapshot.","workflow",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0057-C03",144,276,"A convenience command may explicitly orchestrate a refresh followed by simulation, but the two steps remain separately identifiable.","workflow",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0057-C04",277,385,"Neither an old valid snapshot nor a model version change should alter an already archived original forecast.","workflow",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0061-C01",0,253,"Every run records league_id, season, snapshot ID and collection time, first simulated week, model component versions, official configuration, random seed/path definition, performance mode/precision, source completeness indicators and code/build version.","provenance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0061-C02",254,348,"Past actual results and future projections are distinguishable by fantasy week and as-of time.","provenance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0061-C03",349,430,"Historical replays remain labeled separately from original prospective forecasts.","provenance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0067-C01",0,169,"Before depending on API assumptions, build a read-only diagnostic against the actual current league through espn-api and, as needed, inspected underlying ESPN endpoints.","audit",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0067-C02",170,567,"The audit tests data availability and actual semantics for league identity, scoring, roster sizes/slots and positional eligibility, teams and current ownership, real free agents, week-specific projections and actual fantasy points, statuses/byes, regular-season matchups/standings/points-for/tiebreaks, current and evolving waiver rules, and the exact championship and consolation bracket formats.","audit",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0081-C01",0,244,"Post-M0.5 approval: these unverified historical projection/actual pairs may be used for explicitly provisional exploratory calibration, but they must retain their evidence label and must never be described as authenticated pregame observations.","historical",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0087-C06",536,772,"`PlayerWeek` uses `(player_id, season, scoring_week)` and preserves finite raw values exactly: negative and positive present values remain unchanged with ESPN provenance, explicit zero remains ESPN zero, and missing derives policy zero.","canonical",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0087-C08",845,1210,"The snapshot stores explicit first/final simulation weeks, full intervening player-week coverage, cumulative present standings, dynamic rules, calendar-only regular/postseason matchup periods, per-matchup bracket classifications and explicit scheduled/bye/partial/placeholder states, NFL games/byes, source references, evidence interpretations, and unresolved gaps.","canonical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0087-C09",1211,1341,"Championship, consolation, placement, and unresolved entries can coexist in one postseason period without fabricated participants.","canonical",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0087-C12",1521,1701,"Deterministic schema-v2 JSON rejects incompatible versions and round-trips slot namespaces, nulls, zeros, signed IDs, UTC timestamps, raw enums, structured rule evidence, and gaps.","canonical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0087-C13",1702,1766,"M1.1 does not implement persistence, publication, or simulation.","canonical",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0089-C01",0,325,"M1.2 implements sequential read-only retrieval, in-memory raw source capture/digests, pure ESPN-to-canonical translation, bounded transient retries, player-pool completeness checks, current-versus-future source precedence, critical mutable-state reconciliation, sanitized diagnostics, and audited YAML rule-gap configuration.","audit",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0089-C02",326,453,"The approved schema-v2 amendment preserves raw eligibility slot 25 in a separate observed namespace without inventing capacity.","audit",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0089-C03",454,712,"The repeated 17 October 2026 live acceptance run passed for explicit fully unplayed weeks 8–18, with 14 teams, 1,052 players, 11,572 player-weeks, 49 fantasy matchups, the complete NFL universe, critical-state reconciliation, and deterministic serialization.","audit",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0089-C04",713,888,"Details are in \u005bdocs/ESPN_CANONICAL_ADAPTER.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/7cfb09b4935f3e73bbfdb76e25b1cab102b751c1/docs/ESPN_CANONICAL_ADAPTER.md).","audit",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C01",0,29,"Fetch into temporary staging;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C02",30,89,"validate critical schema, coverage and internal invariants;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C03",90,158,"only then atomically mark a new immutable snapshot simulation-ready.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C04",159,262,"A half-fetched, malformed or wrong-league refresh must fail and leave the last good snapshot untouched.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C05",263,427,"Snapshot validators should be strict about actual missing core league data, not blindly treat every unprojected individual player as a catastrophic refresh failure.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0093-C06",428,475,"Record failure diagnostics and quality metrics.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C01",0,141,"Snapshot age is displayed with clear stale-data warnings, but valid snapshots remain runnable for reproducibility and historical comparisons.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C02",142,217,"Missing or corrupt core data is a blocking error, not a stale-data warning.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C03",218,512,"M1.4 adds a deterministic report outside the canonical document: structural violations still raise precise validation errors, while ordinary missing projections, explicit zeros, finite negatives, unrostered players, and observed unconfigured eligibility categories remain aggregate information.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C04",513,719,"Reports calculate total and week/position/ownership projection coverage from canonical records and disclose unresolved rule capabilities without treating snapshot validity as simulator capability readiness.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C05",720,765,"Refresh and simulation are separate commands.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C06",766,823,"V1 does not require scheduled background ESPN harvesting;","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0095-C07",824,979,"if later useful for research, a lightweight independent scheduled collection task can be built with explicit uptime, credential and retention arrangements.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C01",0,84,"M1.5 implements read-only snapshot listing, selection, inspection, and verification.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C02",85,232,"Compact listings are deterministically newest-first and may filter by league and season without loading canonical objects or raw response payloads.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C03",233,276,"Selection uses an exact UUID when supplied;","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C04",277,362,"otherwise both league and season are required to choose the newest matching snapshot.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C05",363,415,"A missing or corrupt explicit UUID never falls back.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C06",416,583,"Inspection performs one fully verified load, reuses M1.4 quality reporting, calculates informational age from retrieval completion, and keeps summary output sanitized.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C07",584,712,"Teams, rosters, players, projections, rules, schedules, and canonical source-request metadata require explicit detail selection;","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C08",713,760,"raw captured response bodies are never printed.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C09",761,863,"Snapshot-specific verification remains separate from explicit database-wide SQLite/foreign-key checks.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0097-C10",864,926,"These operations neither refresh ESPN nor mutate stored state.","quality",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C01",0,68,"Use lightweight local SQLite as V1's authoritative persistent store.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C02",69,191,"The complete deterministic versioned canonical JSON document is the sole authoritative normalized snapshot representation;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C03",192,252,"no parallel relational team/player/player-week model exists.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C04",253,294,"New publications use canonical schema v4;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C05",295,352,"historical v2/v3 documents remain immutable and readable.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C06",353,590,"SQLite schema v1 stores append-only snapshot metadata, the canonical document bytes and checksum, plus gzip-compressed deterministic JSON representations of every captured ESPN response with request provenance and uncompressed checksums.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C07",591,649,"Each publication receives a new UUID unrelated to content.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C08",650,742,"Retrieval completes before one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction atomically inserts all records;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C09",743,825,"failure before commit rolls back the candidate and never alters earlier snapshots.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C10",826,946,"A subsequent verification failure identifies the already committed UUID and never claims rollback or deletes/retries it.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C11",947,1119,"Published rows reject updates and deletes, all successful refreshes are retained indefinitely by default, and newest selection uses publication UTC time then snapshot UUID.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C12",1120,1348,"Routine reads verify the requested snapshot's database/document versions, identities, canonical and raw checksums, references, decompression, deserialization, and canonical validation without an unconditional database-wide scan;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C13",1349,1429,"explicit integrity diagnostics run both SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C14",1430,1518,"SQLite uses WAL with `synchronous=FULL` and foreign keys on every repository connection.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C15",1519,1591,"Sensitive ESPN cookies/credentials are never stored in request metadata;","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C16",1592,1646,"the database remains a private ignored local artifact.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C17",1647,1739,"Do not introduce Parquet storage, scheduled collection, or completed-scenario caching in V1.","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0101-C18",1740,1908,"Full details are in \u005bdocs/SNAPSHOT_STORAGE.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/7cfb09b4935f3e73bbfdb76e25b1cab102b751c1/docs/SNAPSHOT_STORAGE.md).","publication",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C01",0,181,"Agreed architecture principle: ESPN's current league configuration is the authoritative source for every retrievable rule, not a template to copy into hardcoded fantasy assumptions.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C02",182,340,"During M0, exhaustively inventory which rules, settings and bracket metadata ESPN actually exposes, their authoritative endpoints, schema and interpretations.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C03",341,704,"During each deliberate league refresh, ingest and validate the configured scoring categories/values, roster slots/capacity/eligibility, lineup lock and transaction constraints as relevant, waiver priority/claim behavior, tiebreak rules, regular-season schedule and standings methodology, playoff qualifiers/byes/brackets/round durations and consolation structure.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C04",705,807,"Derive all league mechanics from this versioned, immutable LeagueRules snapshot used by the simulator;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C05",808,921,"a different league or season with a different supported ESPN configuration should work without source-code edits.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C06",922,1019,"Avoid assuming this league's current 14-team/6-playoff/two-week-final structure is globally true.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C07",1020,1152,"Treat rule changes between snapshots as meaningful input changes that require validation and a new reproducible simulation baseline;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0105-C08",1153,1212,"never retroactively mutate a previously simulated snapshot.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C01",0,101,"If a required behavior is not exposed by ESPN or is ambiguous, do not silently invent a generic rule.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C02",102,390,"Record an explicit 'unknown/unverified' state, seek an official ESPN settings page or faithful observed historical bracket/transaction evidence, and allow a clearly labeled, provenance-tracked manual league-specific configuration ONLY as a last resort for an otherwise implementable rule.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C03",391,464,"Critical unresolved mechanics block authoritative results until resolved;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C04",465,557,"noncritical gaps can be disclosed with a justified provisional assumption for research runs.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C05",558,767,"Build adapter-level verification tests against actual ESPN behavior where feasible, and fail loudly when unsupported setting types or schema changes are encountered rather than quietly applying stale defaults.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0107-C06",768,917,"This policy supersedes any illustrative inverse-standings waiver order, PF tiebreak or fixed postseason mapping previously mentioned as if universal.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C01",0,309,"League-level fallback configuration (agreed): Any league-level setting unavailable through the verified ESPN API/endpoints must be represented as an explicit, human-editable per-league configuration value (for example a YAML league config), never hardcoded in simulator logic or scattered across source files.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C02",310,438,"The ingestion layer merges ESPN-exposed values with these fallback values into one validated and versioned LeagueRules snapshot.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C03",439,495,"Precedence is ESPN first for fields it exposes reliably;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C04",496,581,"local config fills absent fields rather than silently overriding known ESPN settings.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C05",582,707,"Record each effective value's source (ESPN vs configured fallback), audit/verification status and retrieval/config timestamp.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C06",708,857,"Provide a concise, documented schema, permitted enumerations and validation errors that tell the user exactly which config key is missing or invalid;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C07",858,978,"keep the common case low-friction so switching leagues or updating rules requires config changes rather than code edits.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C08",979,1050,"Preserve the resolved configuration with every run for reproducibility.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C09",1051,1120,"Surface conflicts between ESPN values and fallback config explicitly;","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C10",1121,1162,"do not quietly accept inconsistent rules.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C11",1163,1315,"This applies to scoring, transactions, standings, roster, postseason and other relevant league mechanics as API coverage dictates, not just tiebreakers.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0109-C12",1316,1476,"Explicit experimental rule overrides, if supported later, must be separately opt-in, visually distinguished and never masquerade as actual ESPN league settings.","rules",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C01",0,244,"Approved missing-projection deterministic-zero correction (WR-022, following R23-06): every generated player-week outcome whose canonical classification is `MISSING` must be exactly `0.0`, regardless of outcome family, dispersion, seed or path.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C02",245,339,"Do not infer missingness from an effective zero or apply any variance to missing observations.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C03",340,417,"Preserve raw missingness/provenance and existing ordinary lineup eligibility.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C04",418,518,"This correction does not change explicit ESPN zero, positive or finite negative projection behavior.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C05",519,693,"Version corrected numerical identities so prior results/checkpoints cannot silently represent different semantics, while preserving all nonmissing random-key bytes and draws.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C06",694,876,"See \u005bdecision and implementation evidence\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/06b408f818d3debd52c6a86793f21dfd697f50f8/docs/MISSING_PROJECTION_ZERO_CORRECTION.md).","missing","historical_or_superseded","historical_or_superseded"],
    ["D8-MS-L0115-C07",877,990,"Fixed observed actuals are not generated outcomes and remain governed by their own evidence/composition contract.","missing",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C01",0,206,"For each unstarted fantasy week, use the latest available ESPN player-specific weekly fantasy point projection as the mean input, with no independent momentum or injury-adjusted forecast of expected points.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C02",207,339,"In V1, a positive effective projection means eligible/available for that week and an effective projection of zero means unavailable.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C03",340,482,"A missing raw projection retains its explicit `missing` quality status but, under the approved conservative policy, derives an effective zero;","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C04",483,529,"a confirmed ESPN zero retains `explicit_zero`.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C05",530,552,"Reassess week by week.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C06",553,615,"ESPN designation alone does not override this heuristic in V1.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C07",616,744,"Do not use simulated realized points or later developments to decide the pre-week lineup or whether a waiver claim should occur.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0117-C08",745,866,"Do not introduce a positional-average, injury-return, replacement-level, or other projection fallback for missing values.","projection",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0119-C01",0,159,"V1 uses the ESPN projection available at snapshot retrieval for every future player-week and does not forecast subsequent revisions to ESPN's published number.","means",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0119-C02",160,325,"Treat the expected adjustment from a future ESPN revision as zero solely as an approved simplifying assumption, not as an empirically validated random-walk property.","means",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0119-C03",326,417,"Apply no forecast-horizon-dependent expected-point adjustment or variance multiplier in V1.","means",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0119-C04",418,515,"Preserve the snapshot time so later runs remain reproducible even if ESPN changes its projection.","means",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C01",0,133,"Draw each player-week’s realized fantasy score from an empirically evaluated uncertainty distribution conditional on ESPN projection;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C02",134,197,"the exact form is UNRESOLVED pending the historical-data audit.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C03",198,299,"Candidate approaches include empirical projection-error resampling and suitable fitted distributions;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C04",300,446,"evaluate by position, projection magnitude, zeros, support (e.g., unrealistic negatives), tails, calibration, sharpness and out-of-sample scoring.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C05",447,529,"Avoid assuming homogeneous errors across QBs, RBs, WRs, TEs, kickers and defenses.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0123-C06",530,668,"The approach should be simple enough to sample cheaply at scale and sufficiently expressive to capture material downside/upside asymmetry.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0125-C01",0,85,"V1 treats individual player outcomes as independent conditional on their projections.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0125-C02",86,173,"That is a practical simplifying assumption, not a scientific claim about real football.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0125-C03",174,369,"Later extensions may add game/team correlation, performance uncertainty changes around injury, and a separate injury/availability stochastic process if empirical evidence supports an improvement.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C01",0,200,"Distribution-family selection (confirmed): Keep empirical conditional projection-error resampling, suitable parametric distributions, and defensible hybrid/smoothed approaches as competing candidates;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C02",201,233,"no method is preselected for V1.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C03",234,395,"Compare each with temporally held-out ESPN projections and realized scores, stratifying calibration diagnostics by position and continuous projected-point level.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C04",396,616,"Assess bias, coverage, log/CRPS or other appropriate proper scores, sharpness, discrete zero mass, permissible negative outcomes, lower and upper tails, stability under sparse data, and runtime at full Monte Carlo scale.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C05",617,704,"Where raw resampling has sparse conditional support, test smoothing or partial pooling;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C06",705,791,"where parametric methods misrepresent asymmetry, zeros or tails, reject or amend them.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C07",792,950,"Prefer the simplest robust method that measurably performs best under these criteria, with an explicit documented fallback and reproducible validation report.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C08",951,1023,"The data audit first establishes which genuine as-of ESPN records exist;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0127-C09",1024,1132,"final distribution form is a later evidence-based M3 decision, not an assumption made in design discussions.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C01",0,247,"A separate potential enhancement to the Monte Carlo player-outcome model is to expand its predictive variance as the number of weeks between an ESPN forecast snapshot and the target game increases, while leaving the ESPN expected points unchanged.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C02",248,501,"Conceptually, use a horizon-conditional scale factor on forecast errors, estimated from honest as-of ESPN pregame and multiweek-ahead snapshots: sigma(position, projection level, lead time) or an empirically estimated variance-ratio by forecast horizon.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C03",502,574,"This reflects possible degradation of longer-horizon forecast precision;","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C04",575,696,"do not assume monotonic growth, a fixed percentage per week, or that variance is the only forecast property that changes.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C05",697,825,"Empirically test whether the errors are actually more dispersed at longer lead times and whether calibration/sharpness improves.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C06",826,926,"Important: a wider player-performance distribution does not mean its expected points are discounted;","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C07",927,999,"nonlinear championship probabilities can change despite unchanged means.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C08",1000,1154,"V1 should initially use the best defensible common residual model unless reliable as-of lead-time-labeled data supports a more complex variance structure.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C09",1155,1388,"The earlier V1 choice to model projection >0 as available and not simulate additional future injuries remains a separate limitation: variance inflation alone cannot substitute for actual missing games or structural availability risk.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0131-C10",1389,1515,"If historical snapshot lead times are unavailable, defer this enhancement or test it prospectively rather than invent a curve.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C01",0,425,"Calibration requirement (agreed): investigate and compare the distribution of ESPN projected-versus-actual fantasy scores conditioned on (i) player position (including QB, RB, WR, TE, K and D/ST as appropriate), (ii) the magnitude of the ESPN point projection (for example, low projected scores such as 3 versus higher values such as 20), and (iii) forecast lead time from the authentic as-of projection snapshot to the game.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C02",426,567,"The conditional mean, residual spread, skewness, probability of zero/near-zero realized scores, upper/lower tails and calibration may differ.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C03",568,782,"Do not presume proportional or constant absolute errors: a three-point projection and a twenty-point projection need not share the same absolute standard deviation, coefficient of variation, or distribution family.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C04",783,872,"Investigate joint interactions rather than assuming three independent correction factors;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C05",873,943,"whether or not horizon variance expands remains an empirical question.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0135-C06",944,1078,"Treat projection=0 in the current V1 league model as unavailable, and missing forecasts as separate from low but positive projections.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C01",0,176,"Implementation selection and overfit control: start with exploratory positional and projection-range summaries, including empirical sample counts and honest pregame timestamps;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C02",177,363,"compare pooled, position-conditioned, projection-level-conditioned and combined/partially pooled models using held-out forecasts and proper probabilistic scoring/calibration diagnostics.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C03",364,588,"Point buckets are primarily exploratory strata, not necessarily discontinuous hard thresholds in production—continuous smooth functions of the ESPN mean, hierarchical shrinkage or minimum-sample fallbacks may be more stable.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C04",589,651,"Avoid overfitting thin position × point-level × horizon cells.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C05",652,855,"Favor the simplest validated model with defensible performance, practical sampling speed and realistic support/tails, and use a documented fallback when historical horizons or group sizes are inadequate.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C06",856,921,"Preserve the ESPN expected-point inputs as the forecasting basis;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C07",922,1006,"uncertainty calibration must not secretly substitute third-party player projections.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0137-C08",1007,1152,"Specific bins, sample thresholds, distribution families and interaction structure remain research decisions after the ESPN historical data audit.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C01",0,276,"Agreed research approach: compare absolute residuals (actual fantasy points minus ESPN projected points), relative errors/ratios (actual divided by projected where safely defined), and alternative conditional predictive models rather than choosing an error scale by intuition.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C02",277,508,"Evaluate how each representation handles very small and zero ESPN projections, negative fantasy outcomes where allowed by scoring rules, heavy tails, asymmetry, heteroskedasticity and differences across positions/projection levels.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C03",509,609,"Ratios may explode at small positive projections and are undefined when projected points equal zero;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C04",610,697,"never silently apply a ratio to zero or conflate missing forecasts with explicit zeros.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C05",698,799,"Compare held-out predictive calibration, proper scores, tail realism and computational sampling cost.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C06",800,944,"Continuous/smoothed conditioning on ESPN point expectation is preferable to arbitrarily discontinuous hard bucket cutoffs when data supports it;","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C07",945,999,"buckets may still be used for descriptive diagnostics.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0141-C08",1000,1122,"Preserve ESPN point projections as the starting means rather than adopting untested systematic changes to expected points.","calibration",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C01",0,183,"Data feasibility distinction: ESPN historical records may expose only a pregame projection for each player-week, not the full sequence of forecasts made several weeks before the game.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C02",184,222,"This is UNVERIFIED until the M0 audit.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C03",223,485,"If only pregame values are available, proceed with robust calibration of position- and projected-score-dependent uncertainty using those genuinely as-of observations, while treating forecast-horizon variance changes as unidentifiable from that historical sample.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C04",486,593,"Do not approximate long-lead forecasts with post-hoc pregame projections or fabricate a horizon multiplier.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C05",594,759,"Revisit horizon effects only if authenticated older snapshot revisions, prospective as-of collection, or another later-approved evidentiary source becomes available.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0143-C06",760,854,"Horizon calibration is useful but not a blocker for the initial Monte Carlo uncertainty model.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C01",0,336,"V1 zero-outcome modeling (agreed): For a player whose ESPN forecast is greater than zero and who is therefore pre-week lineup-eligible, sample a full realistic realized-score distribution that can include exactly zero or near-zero fantasy points and extreme downside when supported by authentic historical projection-to-actual outcomes.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C02",337,427,"Such zero outcomes may reflect poor games, limited play or unanticipated in-game injuries;","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C03",428,472,"the model need not identify the cause in V1.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C04",473,597,"Do not truncate positive-projection player outcomes to be strictly positive or artificially prevent zero-point realizations.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C05",598,859,"Distinguish this stochastic score outcome from the deterministic V1 pre-week availability decision: an explicit ESPN projection of exactly zero rules the player out of that week's projected lineup, while missing projections remain a separate data-quality state.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C06",860,1034,"Do not add an independent injury-absence sampler in V1, since it would potentially double count zero/downside risk already included in the empirical performance distribution.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C07",1035,1246,"Later, a separately validated availability-versus-conditional-performance decomposition may improve realism, but any extension must preserve correct unconditional scoring probabilities and avoid double counting.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0145-C08",1247,1413,"Evaluate conditional zero frequencies by position and projection level and use proper discrete mass where empirically indicated, not an arbitrary universal zero rate.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C01",0,618,"Approved design (subject to empirical validation): Maintain two explicitly distinct projection quantities. (1) Raw ESPN weekly projected fantasy points remain immutable and are the ONLY basis for V1 projected-optimal lineup choices, reactive essential waiver-add ranking, deterministic roster completion and the projected-point replacement-adjusted V(R) heuristic. (2) The PlayerOutcomeModel may apply a versioned, empirically justified conditional bias adjustment to the distribution of REALIZED player-week points sampled by Monte Carlo, based on position, projected level and other supported conditioning variables;","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C02",619,727,"e.g., a raw ESPN projection of 9 may correspond to an empirically calibrated distribution centered around 8.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C03",728,932,"Apply the correction when drawing realized scores after roster actions and lineups are fixed, not as a preprocessing rewrite of ESPN projection fields or automatic rescaling of every model decision input.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C04",933,1019,"The championship/placement probabilities naturally reflect calibrated sampled results.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C05",1020,1140,"Bias corrections must pass relevant held-out/out-of-sample tests and be promoted to the official model under Section 11;","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C06",1141,1205,"no correction is assumed just because an in-sample mean differs.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0149-C07",1206,1361,"Record both raw and calibrated outcome expectations as distinct provenance fields when needed, including their model version, without mutating source data.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0151-C01",0,240,"Interpretation: ESPN-projection-based lineup and waiver policies may cease to be optimal under the calibrated means (e.g., a 9-point ESPN player may be chosen over an 8.5-point ESPN player although their calibrated expected scores reverse).","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0151-C02",241,412,"This is an intentional V1 policy distinction, not an implementation bug: simulate choices based on original ESPN information and assess their true calibrated consequences.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0151-C03",413,571,"Evaluating alternate decision policies using corrected means is a separately validated future experiment, not a consequence of adopting a sampling correction.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0151-C04",572,654,"Corrected-score uncertainty and empirical downside/zero mass must remain coherent;","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0151-C05",655,707,"do not accidentally apply the bias adjustment twice.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C01",0,169,"Bias-correction shrinkage policy (agreed): Estimated systematic ESPN forecast biases should be regularized/shrunk toward no correction when data are sparse or uncertain.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C02",170,365,"The degree of shrinkage should depend on the strength of evidence, effective sample size, instability across seasons and groups, and held-out predictive results, not a fixed arbitrary percentage.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C03",366,521,"Consider hierarchical/partially pooled position- and projection-level estimates, smooth regularized corrections, or other statistically principled methods;","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C04",522,605,"do not adopt a hard bucket-by-bucket raw average error as the automatic adjustment.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C05",606,804,"Corrections may approach the full supported estimate when evidence is strong, but do not promise elimination of all measured bias or introduce a change without meaningful out-of-sample improvements.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C06",805,897,"Ensure testing respects as-of ESPN projections, temporal splits and model-selection leakage.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C07",898,954,"Maintain raw ESPN projections for all decision policies;","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C08",955,1060,"apply only the approved calibrated/shrunk adjustment to simulated player outcomes, not twice or upstream.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0153-C09",1061,1196,"Exact shrinkage method, pooling structure and evidence thresholds remain part of the empirical distribution-model selection workstream.","bias",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C01",0,144,"V1 player-specific uncertainty policy (agreed): Do not add individual-player volatility parameters or player-specific score-error distributions.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C02",145,321,"Conditional performance and correction distributions are group-level functions of position, raw ESPN projected point level and any other separately validated shared covariates;","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C03",322,412,"individual players with the same modeled covariates use the same conditional distribution.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C04",413,539,"This avoids unstable estimates from short, nonstationary player histories and protects the initial model from false precision.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C05",540,819,"Future research enhancement (post-V1, explicitly on roadmap): evaluate player-level residual volatility and distribution shape using sufficiently long, as-of, multi-season ESPN projection/actual histories, accounting for changing usage, team, injuries, role and sample selection.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C06",820,1019,"Require hierarchical shrinkage toward group estimates, minimum effective data, temporal validation, and an out-of-sample improvement in distribution calibration and decision outcomes before adoption.","horizon",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C07",1020,1085,"A group-level zero/downside tail remains allowed for all players;","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0155-C08",1086,1207,"lack of player-specific parameters does not mean identical outcomes for all players regardless of projection or position.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0157-C01",0,195,"V1 dependence assumption (confirmed): Sample all player-week realized scores independently conditional on their raw ESPN projections and the selected group-level calibrated outcome distributions.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0157-C02",196,386,"Do not add quarterback–receiver stacks, teammates/opponents, shared game-script shocks, team-level random factors, player-level latent factors, or across-week injury/usage persistence in V1.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0157-C03",387,587,"This independence assumption governs performance draws, not the deterministic dependence of team outcomes, standings, waiver access and playoff qualification generated by the shared league simulation.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0157-C04",588,833,"Correlation and persistent player-state processes remain post-V1 research enhancements to assess using true joint historical player-week data, robust shrinkage, and impact on calibrated championship probabilities, especially for stacked rosters.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0157-C05",834,1038,"Keep common random numbers for paired scenario variance reduction: sharing a random stream across *counterfactual scenarios* is not a model of correlation between different players within one season path.","independence",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C01",0,102,"V1 negative-score support (agreed): Do not impose an artificial zero floor on realized fantasy scores.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C02",103,433,"Where this league's confirmed ESPN scoring configuration allows negative player-week outcomes (for example through turnovers or negative D/ST scoring), empirical scoring distributions and Monte Carlo samples must retain plausible negative values and respect the support, tails and scoring granularity validated in historical data.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C03",434,539,"A positive ESPN projection governs pre-week availability but does not force a nonnegative realized score.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C04",540,694,"Where a specific position/scoring mechanism cannot yield negative scores under verified league settings, its model should not create impossible negatives.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C05",695,795,"Compare negative-outcome frequency and lower-tail calibration by position and projected point level;","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C06",796,921,"any fitted or resampled distribution must handle permissible signed observations without indiscriminate clamping or rounding.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C07",922,1042,"Include tests confirming negative sampled scores survive roster scoring, matchup totals, standings and postseason logic.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0159-C08",1043,1123,"This policy is separate from the exact-zero and missing-projection distinctions.","signed",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0163-C01",0,121,"Observed fantasy outcomes can test the distribution of projection errors where genuine pregame projections are available.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0163-C02",122,243,"Prospective stored snapshots provide cleaner evidence over time but are initially collected only during explicit refresh.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0163-C03",244,432,"Replaying a new model on old ESPN snapshots can compare computational/model approaches but does not independently validate ESPN’s original forecasts or prove optimal transaction decisions.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0163-C04",433,490,"Preserve dates, model versions and train/test separation;","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0163-C05",491,590,"report if historical forecast data is too sparse or post-hoc revised for strong calibration claims.","historical",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C01",0,109,"Start from the per-path roster ownership, current cumulative standings, waiver priority and free-agent state.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C02",110,192,"Identify positions that CANNOT be legally filled by any AVAILABLE rostered player.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C03",193,292,"Process only the essential acquisitions required to fill these holes before final lineup selection.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C04",293,377,"After any permitted add/drop, optimize a legal lineup using ESPN weekly projections;","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C05",378,397,"freeze that lineup;","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C06",398,456,"then draw fantasy outcomes and resolve scheduled matchups.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C07",457,564,"Update wins/losses, points for, relevant tiebreakers, waiver order and bracket advancement for later weeks.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0169-C08",565,629,"Repeat through the remaining regular season and full postseason.","weekly",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C01",0,188,"Maximize total ESPN projected points across all mandatory starter and flex slots, honoring player eligibility, all relevant league slot constraints and the one-player-one-slot requirement.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C02",189,292,"Bench/eligible flex allocation must be globally optimal, not an error-prone greedy slot-by-slot choice.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C03",293,343,"Select starters before seeing stochastic outcomes.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C04",344,470,"If no roster/free-agent combination can fill a mandatory slot, leave it empty for a zero contribution in that week and log it;","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C05",471,504,"do not invent a synthetic player.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0173-C06",505,616,"Future manager attentiveness, mistaken starts and discretionary streaming are out of scope for the V1 baseline.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C01",0,144,"M2.1 implements this contract as a deterministic exact dynamic program over the configured starter-slot instances and eligible rostered players.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C02",145,201,"Only configured `STARTER` capacity creates destinations;","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C03",202,281,"bench, reserve/IR, and observed-but-unconfigured eligibility categories do not.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C04",282,465,"A candidate must be on the selected modeled roster, outside reserve, eligible for the destination, covered by the requested canonical player-week, and have `effective_projection > 0`.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C05",466,525,"Exact stored float values are compared without a tolerance.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C06",526,700,"Objective ties prefer more filled positions and then the lexicographically stable assignment formed from configured slot ID, within-slot position index, and signed player ID.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C07",701,893,"If a complete lineup is impossible, the optimizer returns the best feasible partial assignment, explicit deterministic vacancies and shortage reasons, with zero contribution from each vacancy.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C08",894,1023,"It accepts a separately validated complete roster state for later path-dependent simulation without mutating the source snapshot.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C09",1024,1163,"Distribution-aware lineup objectives or tie decisions remain a deferred enhancement and must account for matchup and joint outcome context;","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0175-C10",1164,1190,"they are not part of M2.1.","lineup",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C01",0,196,"An essential waiver action occurs ONLY when the upcoming projected legal starting lineup has at least one mandatory vacancy that cannot be filled by any available eligible player already rostered.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C02",197,271,"A merely suboptimal but legal existing player does not justify an upgrade.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C03",272,404,"Candidate additions come from actual available unowned ESPN players in the shared simulation-path pool, respecting league mechanics.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C04",405,553,"A transaction is eligible only when it is necessary and improves the current-week projected legal lineup relative to leaving the vacancy unresolved.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C05",554,783,"Among legal eligible add/drop transactions, select the transaction producing the highest unified remaining-season V(R), even when that choice sacrifices some current-week projected points relative to another eligible transaction.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C06",784,843,"This supersedes the earlier current-week-gain-only ranking;","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0179-C07",844,936,"behavior remains reactive because no transaction occurs without the current vacancy trigger.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0181-C01",0,59,"Process priority according to the actual ESPN league rules.","phases",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0181-C03",261,346,"Each manager may obtain at most one essential player per pass through priority order;","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0181-C04",347,442,"repeat passes for additional unfillable slots until no further legal acquisitions are possible.","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0181-C05",443,498,"Re-evaluate roster/availability/pool after each action.","phases",null,null],
