    ["D8-MS-L0183-C02",133,225,"Immediate free agents execute in reverse order of the initial frozen weekly waiver priority.","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0183-C03",226,523,"This reverse-priority policy is an approved but uncalibrated and replaceable V1 manager-behavior assumption, not an ESPN rule: its provisional rationale is that better-performing managers may be more attentive to immediate opportunities, but that relationship has not been statistically validated.","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0183-C04",524,560,"Preserve the distinction in outputs.","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0183-C05",561,711,"Compare alternative ordering policies in future research and, where feasible, estimate manager-specific activity from historical transaction evidence.","phases",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0185-C01",0,141,"The clear deterministic reference uses exact complete-cycle current-week lookahead over the small legal claim/free-agent allocation universe.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0185-C02",142,257,"Shared player allocation must be eligibility-aware rather than treating positional replacement pools independently.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0185-C03",258,408,"The operational engine retains one shared ownership state, transaction ledger, waiver priority, and dropped-player holding/reentry state across weeks.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0185-C04",409,457,"Verified ESPN transaction rules govern legality;","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0185-C05",458,558,"V(R), essential-only behavior, and manager-processing order are separately labeled modeled policies.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0189-C01",0,130,"Players added via essential waivers are genuinely owned and persist after a bye ends until some later eligible roster transaction.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0189-C02",131,331,"When full, the manager drops a player chosen for minimal replacement-adjusted marginal roster value, accounting for starter use, positional scarcity, future bye/waiver replaceability and roster depth;","essential",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0211-C10",951,1047,"The owner also confirmed that ESPN advances the higher-seeded team after a tied playoff matchup;","standings",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0211-C11",1048,1109,"discretionary League Manager overrides are outside the model.","standings",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0211-C12",1110,1204,"M2.4 executes that rule only when its canonical interpretation is understood as `higher_seed`.","standings",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C01",0,72,"M2.4 implements a settings-driven deterministic immutable state machine.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C02",73,122,"Final modeled standings determine original seeds.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C03",123,318,"Abstract bracket graphs derive sources, byes, rounds, and winner/loser destinations from canonical qualifier counts, round counts, and scoring periods rather than league size or season templates.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C04",319,414,"The fixed no-reseed championship generator uses the next power-of-two field and high-seed byes;","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C05",415,511,"the current six-team output (1-2 byes, 3-6, 4-5, then fixed semifinals) is a validation fixture.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C06",512,609,"Complete placement classification currently fails closed for elimination cohorts larger than two.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C07",610,655,"Canonical round periods supply scoring weeks;","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0217-C08",656,794,"multiweek totals use exact finite supplied scores, and an exact tie advances the higher original seed under the understood canonical rule.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C01",0,121,"Official ESPN rules establish the general Consolation Ladder: every non-qualifier participates throughout the postseason;","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C02",122,173,"first-round pairings are adjacent descending seeds;","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C03",174,239,"the lowest seed receives a bye when the participant count is odd;","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C04",240,361,"winners move upward one matchup position, losers move downward one matchup position, and neither boundary may be crossed.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C05",362,548,"The generic graph applies those movements after every completed round and works unchanged for even participant counts, including independently tested four-, six-, and eight-team ladders.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C06",549,664,"Thus the current eight participants produce the complete verified 2026 graph beginning 7-8, 9-10, 11-12, and 13-14.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C07",665,779,"Original seed and evolving ladder position remain distinct, and championship/consolation membership never crosses.","postseason",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0219-C08",780,900,"The next-round reentry of an odd-field bye remains capability-gated unless explicit validated configuration supplies it.","postseason",null,null],

    ["D8-MS-L0219-C10",947,1087,"See \u005bdocs/POSTSEASON.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/24721d398b480b42de7d2206d9f65826c375f163/docs/POSTSEASON.md).","postseason","historical_or_superseded","historical_or_superseded"],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C01",0,64,"Report every manager’s championship and runner-up probabilities;","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C02",65,115,"playoff qualification, bye and seed distributions;","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C03",116,169,"advancement through each title and consolation round;","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C04",170,200,"each final finishing position;","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C05",201,273,"projected final W/L/T, cumulative PF and other relevant ranking metrics.","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C06",274,370,"Report confidence intervals and uncertainty for probability estimates, not just point estimates.","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0223-C07",371,567,"Outcomes must reconcile: exactly one title winner per simulated season path, normalized advancement/placement distributions, consistent bracket progression and shared player ownership constraints.","outputs",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0227-C01",0,157,"Record aggregate essential transaction frequencies and counts, roster turnover, unfillable slots, and named-player retention/drop probability and weeks held;","diagnostics",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0227-C02",158,231,"explicitly show whether a traded-in player survives or is later replaced.","diagnostics",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0227-C03",232,409,"Preserve detailed chronological transaction/roster histories for a controlled representative subsample and analytically interesting scenarios rather than every simulated season.","diagnostics",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0227-C04",410,521,"Research how to define interesting paths and sampling so they are informative without exploding memory/storage.","diagnostics",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0233-C01",0,185,"Build a single configurable V(R) estimating the remaining-horizon value of a legal roster in terms of projected optimal starters plus positional depth/replaceability and future waivers.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0233-C02",186,264,"Automatic drop chooses the player producing the smallest decrease V(R)−V(R\\p);","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0233-C03",265,407,"automatic refill chooses the unowned player yielding the largest increase V(R+p)−V(R), considering eligibility and overall roster composition.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0233-C04",408,512,"Avoid selecting gross-high-point quarterbacks just because their raw projections exceed other positions.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0233-C05",513,602,"Explicit user-pinned players in hypothetical completion are protected from auto-reversal.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C01",0,140,"The valuation should recognize future bye weeks and replacement free agents so it does not overvalue bench backups needed for a single week;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C02",141,204,"should distinguish scarcity of viable players across positions;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C03",205,301,"and should consider every remaining scoring week at equal weight in V1, without a time discount.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C04",302,385,"No nested full Monte Carlo for each roster move inside every simulated waiver step.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C05",386,528,"Exact computational approximation and replacement levels remain OPEN research questions requiring measured decision quality/performance tests;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0235-C06",529,570,"temporal weights are fixed equally in V1.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C01",0,208,"Hybrid valuation architecture (agreed): V(R) is a fast, replacement-adjusted, expected-lineup-points-oriented proxy for high-frequency local decisions such as routine drops and hypothetical roster completion.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C02",209,437,"It must incorporate realistic future coverage of starting slots, positional scarcity, bye weeks, replacement availability and equal V1 weighting across remaining weeks, rather than a loose raw total of rostered projected points.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C03",438,613,"The full paired Monte Carlo league simulator—not V(R)—is the authoritative evaluator of each consequential completed counterfactual and its effect on championship probability.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C04",614,752,"Never nest full-season Monte Carlo inside each season path's waiver/drop loop: that creates intractable simulation-within-simulation work.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C05",753,894,"Validate the proxy by comparing its ordering and selected roster decisions with higher-fidelity full-simulation benchmarks on sampled states;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C06",895,962,"improve or replace the proxy when it materially misranks decisions.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0237-C07",963,1029,"Exact V(R) approximation and calibration remain open for research.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C01",0,215,"Approved V1 design direction: V(R) must account for the future ability to obtain a replacement from the REAL shared ESPN free-agent pool, including competition from other managers, but cannot use nested Monte Carlo.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C02",216,311,"Begin with a computationally cheap, transparent heuristic, then improve it based on validation.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C03",312,708,"At each relevant future week and position/slot, estimate (a) pool quality and depth of eligible unrostered players, (b) the manager's likely access to that quality, using actual waiver priority/rules and anticipated essential vacancies on competing teams where predictable from projected availability, and (c) a conservative availability adjustment when multiple teams might seek the same player.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C04",709,849,"A positional replacement tier, probability-weighted quality estimate or similar efficient approximation is a candidate, not a fixed formula.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C05",850,1004,"Apply replacement credit only to comparable legal starting slots and avoid assuming either zero access or guaranteed access to the single best free agent.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C06",1005,1251,"Do not introduce unsupported speculative future claims into the V1 baseline: V(R)'s approximation forecasts the opportunity cost of depth, while the actual season simulator still executes only its specified essential path-dependent waiver events.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C07",1252,1304,"Track assumptions, sensitivity and computation cost.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C08",1305,1414,"Benchmark the heuristic against fully simulated replacement outcomes and scenario rankings on sampled states;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C09",1415,1451,"refine post-V1 as evidence supports.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0241-C10",1452,1549,"Exact future demand model, choice of replacement tier and calibration remain open research items.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C01",0,278,"V1 replacement-demand policy (agreed): estimate competition only from future mandatory lineup vacancies directly identifiable in the current validated ESPN snapshot: each other manager’s roster, positional eligibility, byes, and week-specific ESPN projection-based availability.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C02",279,398,"For each future week, test whether that manager can fill all required starter slots from its existing available roster;","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C03",399,476,"count only demonstrable unfillable vacancies as anticipated essential demand.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C04",477,608,"Do not posit injury events, voluntary upgrades, speculative waiver claims, or assumed roster turnover to inflate competition in V1.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C05",609,744,"This is a present-information approximation: as future simulated waiver actions and standings evolve, realized competition will differ;","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C06",745,854,"use the full path-dependent league simulator to validate and improve the shortcut without nesting it in V(R).","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C07",855,980,"Future extensions may incorporate empirically grounded uncertain demand, but no arbitrary probability premium is assumed now.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0243-C08",981,1082,"Ensure assumptions do not imply foresight of unknown future acquisitions or realized player outcomes.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C01",0,294,"V1 waiver-access uncertainty heuristic (agreed): Because V(R) values a roster player's marginal expected starting-point contribution rather than making an actual future waiver claim, do not explicitly forecast the full path of future standings or each future week's waiver priority within V(R).","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C02",295,602,"Instead, estimate attainable replacement quality from the ESPN free-agent pool and identifiable competing teams' starter gaps, then apply a transparent, bounded uncertainty/access adjustment (conceptually a discount to optimistic replacement quality) to reflect that the best replacement may be taken first.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C03",603,787,"This adjustment can depend on free-agent positional depth, the number of competing known vacancies, proximity of the target week and, for imminent claims, presently known waiver order;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C04",788,884,"precise formula and parameters remain empirical research questions, not adopted numeric factors.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C05",885,1034,"Preserve nonnegative, plausible replacement point estimates and avoid double-counting competition already reflected in the selected replacement tier.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C06",1035,1140,"The simulation engine itself must still execute actual path-dependent essential waivers under ESPN rules;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C07",1141,1188,"the heuristic only affects the fast V(R) proxy.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0245-C08",1189,1318,"Compare proxy estimates with replacement outcomes observed in the full simulator to calibrate and later upgrade the access model.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C01",0,194,"V1 future free-agent pool assumption (agreed): Begin replacement valuation with the real current unrostered ESPN player pool, using each player's published projection for the target future week.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C02",195,463,"Account approximately for foreseeable changes arising from already specified essential waiver mechanics—known bye-week and ESPN-projection-based starter shortages across teams, associated claims from that shared pool, and resulting roster drops/re-entry when eligible.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C03",464,685,"A cheap forward deterministic approximation or cached per-week pool/depth estimates may be used to reflect such expected essential transactions without spawning separate stochastic league simulations for every V(R) query.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C04",686,792,"Actual essential pickups, roster releases and priority remain path-dependent in the full season simulator;","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C05",793,893,"V(R) is a proxy and must not claim perfect knowledge of which exact players will still be available.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C06",894,1035,"Do not add speculative pickups, voluntary upgrades, trades, surprise injuries or other discretionary future turnover to the V1 pool forecast.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C07",1036,1224,"Where future claims are ambiguous, use the previously agreed bounded access/uncertainty adjustment and clearly document its assumptions, rather than inventing specific future transactions.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0247-C08",1225,1349,"Validate the approximate future pool against recorded outcomes in full simulations and revisit only with demonstrated value.","valuation_research",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C01",0,451,"V1 bench-depth and insurance policy (agreed): The fast V(R) proxy credits a rostered bench player only for identifiable projected opportunities to contribute to a legal optimal starting lineup across remaining weeks—such as starters' known byes, weeks of ESPN-projected unavailability, and weeks the bench player himself projects to enter the optimal lineup—and the points contributed above a realistically accessible competition-adjusted replacement.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C02",452,619,"Do not add a separate speculative injury-insurance premium or generic positional-depth bonus for unknown future injuries, surprise absences or unmodeled roster events.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C03",620,787,"A bench player with no expected projected starts may therefore have negligible marginal V1 value, apart from any demonstrated effect under the explicit existing rules.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C04",788,946,"This matches the V1 simulation's decision not to generate independent unexpected injuries, and avoids rewarding risks that the baseline itself cannot realize.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C05",947,1119,"Evaluate an explicit calibrated insurance component only in a future version alongside expanded uncertainty/availability modeling and evidence of improved decision quality.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0249-C06",1120,1200,"Keep this distinction transparent when describing limited bench depth valuation.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C01",0,214,"7.V1 temporal weighting policy (agreed): In the fast replacement-adjusted roster value V(R), give every remaining projected scoring week equal weight when aggregating expected marginal legal starting-lineup points;","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C02",215,293,"do NOT apply time-based discounts or preemptively overweight postseason weeks.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C03",294,383,"Keep realistic weekly availability, replacement access, and actual roster/lineup effects;","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C04",384,523,"equal weighting applies to projected point contributions, not an assumption that all weeks have identical impact on winning a championship.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C05",524,631,"Full paired Monte Carlo measures the actual playoff/championship implications of week-specific performance.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C06",632,742,"Time-importance weighting is deferred unless separately demonstrated to improve the proxy's decision rankings.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0251-C07",743,836,"This policy supersedes earlier exploratory references to empirically discounted future weeks.","valuation",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0253-C01",0,41,"3 Two uses with distinct local objectives","history",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0255-C01",0,225,"For the simulation’s reactive essential acquisition, require positive current-week projected legal lineup improvement, then choose the legal necessary transaction with the highest resulting remaining-horizon V(R) (Section 5).","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0255-C02",226,375,"For deterministic INITIAL completion of a manual hypothetical scenario, use remaining-horizon marginal V(R) for filling roster vacancies (Section 8).","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0255-C03",376,511,"The same unified value policy supports both additions and cuts, but the transaction triggers and allocation procedures remain distinct.","essential",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C01",0,146,"The core counterfactual evaluator accepts coherent roster-state modifications affecting any manager(s), not exclusively trade-for-trade exchanges.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C02",147,295,"Manual instructions can include explicit player transfers between teams, acquiring currently unrostered ESPN players, and dropping existing players.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C03",296,356,"V1 changes take effect just before the first simulated week;","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C04",357,427,"no midseason scheduled actions or overriding league lineup-size rules.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C05",428,473,"Track ownership and prevent invented players.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0261-C06",474,645,"Scenario inputs may be temporarily overfilled/underfilled while being specified, but every actual simulated starting state must be structurally achievable, full and legal.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0263-C01",0,117,"A hypothetical does not have to correspond to a convincing sequence of accepted trade offers or current waiver locks;","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0263-C02",118,250,"the automatic optimizer, in contrast, must distinguish actionable/executable recommendations and acquisition/acceptance uncertainty.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0263-C03",251,367,"The user’s explicit moves are intentional binding constraints for scenario completion even when analytically unwise.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0263-C04",368,448,"The scenario is not permission to duplicate ownership or ignore roster capacity.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0267-C01",0,143,"Stage 1: Apply explicit transfers, acquisitions and removals, reconcile source owners and the unrostered pool, and preserve user-directed pins.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0267-C02",144,262,"Stage 2: Across affected teams, make ALL necessary automatic roster-capacity drops before choosing incidental pickups;","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0267-C03",263,352,"released players immediately become available to the shared hypothetical completion pool.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0267-C04",353,548,"Stage 3: Refill all roster vacancies up to normal capacity, using remaining-season V(R), in round-robin allocation ordered by current real ESPN waiver priority, at most one add per team per pass.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0267-C05",549,700,"This order is a deterministic fairness heuristic for hypothetical completion, NOT a claim that actual waiver acquisitions could occur exactly this way.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0269-C01",0,198,"Any currently unrostered ESPN player can be chosen during initial hypothetical completion even if currently on real waiver lockdown, because the purpose is to create a coherent counterfactual state.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0269-C02",199,287,"Completion is computed ONCE before Monte Carlo simulation, not anew in each season path.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0269-C03",288,417,"At simulation start, explicit pins expire: a later simulated essential waiver event may legally drop the initially forced player.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0269-C04",418,554,"If no legal, full roster can be created while honoring pins, report infeasibility rather than silently changing the user’s chosen edits.","manual",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0273-C01",0,220,"Baseline and scenario use an IDENTICAL immutable ESPN source snapshot and the same player-week random shocks, keyed by stable player/week/path IDs, so estimated probability differences benefit from common random numbers.","paired",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0273-C02",221,367,"They may diverge in future roster acquisitions, waiver priority and lineups because those are genuine downstream consequences of the hypothetical.","paired",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0273-C03",368,606,"Show absolute champion probabilities, scenario-minus-baseline differences with paired uncertainty intervals, impacts on every team in the configured league, seed/bye/playoff and placement changes, and concrete roster/turnover diagnostics.","paired",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0275-C01",0,120,"Rank candidate scenarios by EXPECTED improvement in championship probability, not by requiring statistical significance.","progressive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0275-C02",121,189,"For large screens, guard against multiple-comparison winner’s curse;","progressive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0275-C03",190,346,"use distinct scenario-difference precision targets from baseline absolute-probability targets and reserve further detailed sampling for promising finalists.","progressive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0281-C01",0,190,"V1 baseline future roster evolution intentionally includes only essential waivers, not speculative trade/streaming actions, since manager preferences and execution probabilities are unknown.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0281-C02",191,316,"That limitation does not prevent examining current feasible trades and waiver acquisitions as counterfactual starting states.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0281-C03",317,535,"A standalone future waiver analyzer can subsequently quantify available-player pickup value, waiver order/priority competition, streaming flexibility and likelihood of success under explicit models of manager behavior.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0281-C04",536,618,"Do not equate completed historical trades with an unbiased acceptance probability.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0285-C01",0,140,"After validating the manual scenario evaluator, construct legal single-step candidate generation for trades, waiver claims and roster moves.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0285-C02",141,259,"Respect team/roster ownership, roster capacity, actual transaction constraints and a configured set of counterparties.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0285-C03",260,423,"Use cheap deterministic proxies/surrogate valuation to discard poor candidates, fast paired simulation to shortlist, and detailed paired evaluations for finalists.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0285-C04",424,578,"Return expected championship probability gain, sampling uncertainty, roster-change explanation, effects on other managers and practical execution caveats.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0285-C05",579,676,"Sellability/acceptance modeling is separate from whether the hypothetical roster outcome is good.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C01",0,157,"Current decision: Configure the search as three independent stages: candidate universe, optional attractiveness screening, and paired Monte Carlo evaluation.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C02",158,209,"Trade structures and partner sets are configurable.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C03",210,260,"Convenience presets are editable, not fixed modes.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C04",261,342,"Allow screening to be turned off for exhaustive evaluation of a bounded universe.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C05",343,447,"Include a pre-run small benchmark on the current hardware to estimate candidate counts and elapsed time;","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C06",448,482,"do not depend on past run timings.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C07",483,614,"Let users set confidence level, target confidence-interval half-width in percentage points, and computational limits independently.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0287-C08",615,738,"The estimator must distinguish candidate coverage from statistical precision and disclose uncertainty in projected runtime.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C01",0,153,"Pre-run benchmark design: Run a small, bounded representative sample using the current engine, league snapshot, worker configuration and actual hardware.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C02",154,289,"Measure candidate-generation and legality-check throughput, roster-completion/V(R) throughput, and paired season-simulation throughput.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C03",290,384,"Estimate the finite candidate universe before starting when combinatorial enumeration permits.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C04",385,513,"If candidate screening is enabled, use an explicit retained-count setting or a short sampled pass to estimate the survival rate.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C05",514,591,"Derive an approximate runtime range and likely bottleneck from the benchmark;","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C06",592,682,"distinguish sampling cost from complete-run cost and do not assume perfect linear scaling.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C07",683,766,"Do not require storing prior-run histories or relying on previous timing estimates.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C08",767,978,"Since adaptive statistical precision changes required simulation counts, show scenarios or ranges, provide runtime and candidate-count ceilings, and revise the estimate from measured throughput during execution.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0289-C09",979,1084,"The preflight benchmark is optional/skippable, with no fabricated time estimate when it has not been run.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C01",0,280,"Exhaustive generation versus exhaustive numerical evaluation (confirmed): The search universe, discretionary candidate screens, and paired Monte Carlo evaluation are independently selectable across single and multi-step trade, waiver, streaming and combined transaction workflows.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C02",281,475,"The 'exhaustive' candidate setting enumerates every feasible member of a finite defined search universe, including intermediate states with negative V(R) that can enable a favorable final state;","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C03",476,564,"it does not automatically guarantee converged Monte Carlo estimates for every candidate.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C04",565,743,"Separately configurable evaluation coverage and path/precision/time budgets determine which enumerated candidates are simulated and with what confidence, with transparent status.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C05",744,826,"Allow an explicitly chosen full-evaluation setting where computationally feasible.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C06",827,1013,"Always distinguish ruled-out illegal candidates, filtered-but-feasible candidates, enumerated-but-unsimulated candidates, simulated preliminary candidates and fully converged candidates.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0291-C07",1014,1126,"No undisclosed fixed shortlist, pruning step or hidden threshold may remove legal candidates in exhaustive mode.","exhaustive",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C01",0,140,"A chain is evaluated by propagating intermediate legal ownership states and available-player pools, not simply adding isolated trade values.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C02",141,232,"Configurable chain length, candidate filtering and partner sets bound combinatorial growth.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C03",233,546,"The next transaction should depend meaningfully on a player acquired in earlier stages: in a three-transaction chain, transaction three must involve at least one player gained from transaction one or two, with a permitted exception where a subsequent trade's dependency is preserved via intermediate acquisitions.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C04",547,609,"Do not immediately revisit the most recent trade counterparty;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C05",610,674,"revisiting an earlier partner with different players is allowed.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C06",675,748,"Recompute implications for the final state with the paired season engine;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0295-C07",749,823,"never permit duplicate ownership or optimistic future information leakage.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0297-C01",0,200,"Detailed trading feasibility, trade acceptance and waiver order outcomes need their own appropriate evidence and must not be confused with the deterministic hypothetical scenario-completion heuristic.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0297-C02",201,310,"Automated search may expand beyond simple trades to combined trade/waiver sequences as methods are validated.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C01",0,196,"Multi-transaction timing constraint (confirmed V1): All transactions in an evaluated chain are hypothetical immediate/pre-simulation actions at the SAME current league snapshot and decision point.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C02",197,488,"Execute them sequentially only to track changing player ownership, shared free-agent availability, legal transaction feasibility and dependencies: for example, Team A may trade with B, after which B can use newly acquired players in a trade with C, all as part of the current proposed chain.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C03",489,739,"Do NOT schedule steps in separate future fantasy weeks, advance the league calendar or standings between chain steps, apply forecasted future transaction opportunities, assume future manager decisions, or run interim season simulations between steps.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C04",740,950,"After the full chain has been applied and its resulting roster state completed under the agreed scenario rules, run ONE league-wide paired future-season simulation for the resulting final state versus baseline;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C05",951,1032,"compare intermediate chain states cheaply with V(R) as appropriate for screening.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C06",1033,1120,"Continue to use the current as-of ESPN weekly projections to value immediate decisions;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C07",1121,1234,"'before projections' means before projecting/simulating season outcomes, not before retrieving projection inputs.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C08",1235,1405,"Distinct future-week contingent or scheduled trade plans are explicitly deferred beyond V1, and their timing/execution uncertainty would require separate future research.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0299-C09",1406,1499,"Trade order matters for legal ownership and acceptability even though no fantasy week passes.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C01",0,195,"Intermediate chain roster-capacity policy (agreed): Permit temporary underfilled or overfilled roster sizes BETWEEN immediate transaction steps during hypothetical multi-trade chain construction;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C02",196,309,"do not force completion to exact capacity after every step or prune a chain solely for an intermediate imbalance.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C03",310,403,"Maintain exactly one owner per player and legal transfer/eligibility semantics as applicable;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C04",404,473,"later chain steps may use newly acquired players and cure imbalances.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C05",474,750,"After the entire chain, perform the agreed once-only deterministic roster-completion process (drops first, then additions under the scenario-completion policy) and require every team's final roster to satisfy league structural constraints BEFORE paired full-season simulation.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C06",751,1071,"Distinguish hypothetical structural validity from ESPN transaction-by-transaction execution feasibility: if an intermediate overfull roster or other step violates ESPN's actual trade-processing rules, label the chain as a what-if or require an explicit intervening drop/roster operation for an actionable recommendation;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C07",1072,1140,"do not assert ESPN would accept an illegal intermediate transaction.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C08",1141,1230,"Any requisite drops or adds must update the shared player pool and ownership immediately.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0301-C09",1231,1321,"Keep acceptance likelihood separately modeled and do not schedule later-week transactions.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C01",0,224,"Chain pickup priority is VACANCY-BASED (corrected policy): Associate an incidental free-agent pickup opportunity with the MANAGER WHO HAS AN EMPTY ROSTER SLOT, not the counterparty who must drop a player for excess capacity.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C02",225,386,"Record transaction-ordered vacancy-creation events as the explicit trades execute, with originating transaction index, affected manager, and required open slots.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C03",387,488,"A trade's capacity drop by the other manager is a separate event that contributes to the shared pool;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C04",489,544,"it does not determine the pickup recipient or priority.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C05",545,751,"After the entire explicit trade chain, resolve ALL required automatic capacity drops before ANY free-agent additions, so a manager with an early vacancy may select any player dropped by a later transaction.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C06",752,931,"At pickup time, use chronological priority of outstanding roster-vacancy creation (not first appearance in a trade, initiating role, drop chronology, or normal ESPN waiver order).","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C07",932,1079,"Give the highest-priority manager all pickups necessary to fill remaining vacancies before proceeding to the next manager, rather than round-robin.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C08",1080,1259,"For the same manager with vacancies created at several trade steps, retain the earliest outstanding vacancy priority and fill all remaining slots when that manager's turn arrives.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C09",1260,1428,"If a later trade removes or fills an earlier vacancy, recompute outstanding vacancies from the actual resulting roster state rather than granting a fictitious addition;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C10",1429,1478,"check the event ledger against final obligations.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C11",1479,1629,"Under the intended two-party trade mechanics, we expect no genuinely simultaneous conflicting vacancy events for distinct managers in one transaction;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C12",1630,1728,"ASSERT/CHECK this expectation, do not hardcode it as an impossibility or add a made-up tiebreaker.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C13",1729,1844,"On an unhandled conflict or event-ledger mismatch, fail with a precise diagnostic instead of silently resolving it.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C14",1845,1925,"Final rosters must be legal before the one league-wide paired season simulation.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C15",1926,2064,"This is a hypothetical immediate chain-completion policy, separate from ESPN's real waiver timing and subsequent simulated weekly waivers.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C16",2065,2177,"Do not deduplicate distinct chains until final completed league states and all simulation-relevant inputs match;","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0303-C17",2178,2216,"preserve alternate transaction routes.","chain",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C01",0,303,"Candidate-generation optimization and exhaustive-reference policy (confirmed): Implement a straightforward, auditable exhaustive enumerator as the reference for every user-defined finite, legally feasible transaction universe, covering single trades, multi-trade chains, waivers and combined move types.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C02",304,460,"The reference enumerator must retain distinct valid transaction sequences even when they transfer the same players or reach the same intermediate ownership;","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C03",461,628,"the ORDER of trades can alter vacancy-creation chronology, automatic capacity drops, pickup precedence, final free-agent assignments, and therefore final league state.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C04",629,747,"Never deduplicate merely on a multiset of players traded, unordered transaction list, or intermediate ownership alone.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C05",748,1084,"In initial implementation, use automatic exact post-completion final-state deduplication for Monte Carlo, plus safe caching/reuse of candidate expansion, legality, and V(R) work ONLY when all inputs influencing the reused computation match (including history-dependent chain restrictions and vacancy-event information where applicable).","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C06",1085,1134,"Keep separate records for every transaction path.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C07",1135,1305,"A sophisticated graph/DAG merging equivalent intermediate states is deferred until measured candidate-generation bottlenecks justify its engineering and correctness risk.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C08",1306,1533,"Validate every future optimization against the simple exhaustive reference on small tractable universes: it must return exactly the same legal sequence set, completed state per sequence, and simulated-state equivalence classes.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C09",1534,1670,"Test adversarial permutations where the traded-player set is identical but transaction order changes roster pickups and final ownership.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C10",1671,1768,"If coverage diverges, fail with diagnostics rather than accepting a faster but incomplete search.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0305-C11",1769,1893,"Profile candidate generation, roster completion, V(R), and Monte Carlo separately before investing in more aggressive reuse.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C01",0,255,"Incremental enumeration and bounded-batch execution (confirmed): Implement legal candidate enumeration as a streaming iterator/generator, not as a requirement to materialize the entire possible single-trade, chain, waiver or combined-move universe in RAM.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C02",256,455,"Process candidates incrementally in configurable bounded batches through legality/roster completion, exact state fingerprinting, optional screening, and selected paired Monte Carlo evaluation stages.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C03",456,568,"Use bounded queues/backpressure to prevent a fast generator from overwhelming slower V(R) or simulation workers.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C04",569,784,"Retain queryable candidate metadata and evaluation-status records for the current search in a disk-backed local database or equivalent, without permanently archiving stale runs or requiring all candidates in memory.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C05",785,860,"Allocate one shared simulation result per canonical completed league state;","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C06",861,932,"preserve all distinct input transaction sequences linked to that state.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C07",933,1210,"Deterministic candidate IDs, explicit stable ordering or equivalent indexing, seeded path-indexed random streams, and controlled result aggregation must yield the same feasible candidate set and statistical results regardless of batch sizes, worker counts, or processing order.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C08",1211,1428,"Never discard valid candidates solely because a memory/queue limit is hit: apply backpressure, or stop with an explicit incomplete-coverage status and diagnostic when an approved computational cap prevents completion.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C09",1429,1516,"Track generated, legally feasible, screened, simulated and converged counts separately;","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C10",1517,1603,"progress estimates and optional runtime benchmarks must reflect those distinct stages.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C11",1604,1689,"Preserve checkpoint/resume only within the explicitly approved operational lifecycle.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C12",1690,1835,"Test streamed/batched enumeration against the simple exhaustive reference on tractable universes and across multiple batch/worker configurations.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0307-C13",1836,1915,"Batching is an implementation optimization, never an undisclosed search filter.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C01",0,204,"Agreed output architecture: Treat each completed automated search as a queryable collection of candidate transactions and their observed evaluation outcomes, not merely a sorted top-N recommendation list.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C02",205,380,"Preserve a stable transaction/scenario identifier, canonical member/player IDs and names, positions, sending/receiving sides, participating teams, trade shape and chain steps;","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C03",381,525,"each candidate's screening stage/status, legality, projected roster-value metrics, Monte Carlo path count, convergence and confidence intervals;","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C04",526,768,"and league-wide baseline/scenario championship probabilities, paired probability changes and other measured outputs available from the engine (playoff probabilities, placement, roster/starting-point effects, and relevant per-team statistics).","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C05",769,911,"Keep one normalized per-scenario summary plus a related per-team outcome table keyed by run/scenario/team, avoiding wide fragile report files.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C06",912,1245,"Users must be able to dynamically sort, filter and search the evaluated candidates by team, individual player, positional composition, trade sizes, probability thresholds, numerical statistics, uncertainty, quality/status and any combination of these, including comparison of the two trade participants and impacts on other managers.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C07",1246,1423,"Default order can be the viewer's championship-probability improvement, but that is a presentation/query preference and must never change or rerun underlying evaluated outcomes.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C08",1424,1656,"Support multi-sort, ascending/descending direction, ranges and cross-team conditions where practical, using indexed temporary SQLite records or another validated local query layer rather than requiring inspection of many flat files.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C09",1657,1759,"Clearly differentiate candidates that were only generated/screened from candidates actually simulated;","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C10",1760,1845,"unsimulated candidates cannot be filtered or ranked on invented Monte Carlo outcomes.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C11",1846,1964,"Preliminary simulated candidates remain searchable but have explicit not-yet-converged labels and actual per-team CIs.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C12",1965,2145,"Active-results retention (latest decision): Do NOT automatically save each trade/waiver search as a permanent run dataset or maintain a growing archive of stale candidate outcomes.","retention",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C13",2146,2340,"Keep only the current search's evaluated transaction summaries, per-team outcomes, filters, and necessary run context in memory or temporary queryable local storage while the analysis is active.","retention",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C14",2341,2475,"Clear or replace those temporary results when starting a fresh analysis, closing the session, or after bounded temporary-file cleanup;","retention",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C15",2476,2587,"long-running operational recovery checkpoints are governed separately and are not a historical results archive.","retention",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C16",2588,2711,"Preserve the current league snapshot/model/settings identity in the active result context so conclusions are interpretable.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C17",2712,2892,"Provide an explicit user-requested download/export action with transaction attributes, all-team results, confidence intervals, simulation counts, and model/snapshot/as-of metadata.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C18",2893,2939,"Export must be optional rather than automatic.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C19",2940,3041,"Previously exported files belong to the user and should not be silently imported into newer searches.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C20",3042,3205,"The local web results explorer should sort/filter the current analysis without rerunning Monte Carlo and clearly mark if data was superseded by a new ESPN refresh.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C21",3206,3321,"A minimal developer CLI may expose diagnostics or equivalent exports, but it is not a parallel interactive product.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0311-C22",3322,3433,"Large results must support indexed/on-demand querying rather than loading all per-path simulations into memory.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C01",0,284,"Export scope (agreed): Support both (1) exporting ALL candidates in the current analysis that received any Monte Carlo evaluation, including preliminary and fully refined results, and (2) exporting only the CURRENT FILTERED result subset according to the active query/search criteria.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C02",285,377,"Preserve the selected sort and document applied filters and export scope in export metadata.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C03",378,458,"Never portray unsimulated candidates as having calculated championship outcomes.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C04",459,713,"Include complete transaction identifiers, teams/players/positions, simulation path counts, estimated probabilities and league-wide deltas, confidence intervals, whether each target was met, relevant run configuration/model version and ESPN snapshot date.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C05",714,812,"Export is explicitly user-initiated and does not imply automatic permanent storage of search runs.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0313-C06",813,987,"Implement both options through the same application query layer so the web interface and any retained developer CLI produce consistent datasets without rerunning simulations.","query",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0315-C01",0,186,"Trade explorer design: Use a compact high-level summary for each evaluated transaction with visual emphasis on the change in championship probability, uncertainty, and evaluation status.","explorer",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0315-C02",187,295,"Allow click-through detail for all league teams, playoff outcomes, roster changes, and confidence intervals.","explorer",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0315-C03",296,381,"Keep filtering, sorting, precise numbers, and downloadable tabular results available.","explorer",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0315-C04",382,449,"Choose specific visualizations using representative data during M7;","explorer",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0315-C05",450,510,"do not let presentation choices redefine analytical meaning.","explorer",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C01",0,78,"Agreed separation: Evaluate trade outcomes and trade acceptance independently.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C02",79,189,"Legal feasibility is an objective constraint from ESPN ownership, roster/transaction rules and trade settings;","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C03",190,231,"violations exclude a trade as actionable.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C04",232,439,"Conditional transaction value is determined by the same league-wide paired Monte Carlo counterfactual, assuming the trade occurs, with championship-probability changes and uncertainty reported for ALL teams.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C05",440,687,"Another manager's willingness to ACCEPT a proposed trade is a separate, uncertain analysis layer, never an input that modifies simulated player performances, underlying roster-state counterfactuals, random paths or full-league championship deltas.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0319-C06",688,886,"The same trade should have identical conditional Monte Carlo outcomes regardless of which manager proposes/views it, even if each side's estimated acceptance likelihood or preferred ranking differs.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C01",0,321,"Acceptance/sellability research may consider counterparty projected ESPN-point changes, expected starting-lineup/roster value V(R), positional needs/depth, observed manager behavior and other justified evidence, but must not equate 'beneficial to both sides' with guaranteed acceptance or assign fabricated probabilities.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C02",322,501,"Start with transparent directional partner-value diagnostics and optional user filters, such as requiring a minimum projected benefit or limiting estimated harm to the other team;","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C03",502,633,"calibrated acceptance probabilities should only be offered when suitable historical or prospective evidence actually supports them.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C04",634,807,"Keep the search objective (e.g. maximize a selected manager's championship gain), acceptance filters, and statistical evaluation precision as distinct configurable settings.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C05",808,983,"In result displays and exports show the counterparty's conditional championship impact and any independently estimated acceptability information side by side, clearly labeled;","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C06",984,1123,"do not multiply championship delta by a speculative acceptance rate as the default ranking or mislabel an unattractive trade as impossible.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0321-C07",1124,1300,"Future multi-transaction or waiver-execution logic can explicitly model probability of successful execution when justified, without contaminating the conditional outcome model.","acceptance",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C01",0,328,"Initial counterparty-attractiveness metric (agreed): Use the SAME fast, ESPN-projection-based, replacement-adjusted V(R) policy as elsewhere in the project to calculate each trade participant's marginal roster-value change, delta V(R) = V(R after proposed transaction and lawful roster completion) minus V(R before transaction).","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C02",329,580,"In particular, the receiving manager's delta V(R) provides the primary simple indicator of whether the offer improves their projected starting opportunities, considering lineup eligibility, byes, positional scarcity and foreseeable replacement access.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C03",581,632,"Calculate it for both participants for consistency;","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C04",633,783,"also make raw ESPN projected-point or lineup-point differences available as optional transparent diagnostics, not competing primary valuation engines.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C05",784,941,"A positive partner delta V(R) is NOT a quantified acceptance probability or guaranteed agreement, and a negative value does not conclusively imply rejection.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C06",942,1131,"Keep this attractiveness screen separately configurable from legal trade feasibility, the requester's ranking objective and league-wide paired championship-probability Monte Carlo outcomes.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C07",1132,1250,"Do not silently discard every trade with a negative counterparty delta unless the user explicitly enables that filter.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C08",1251,1329,"More sophisticated behavior/acceptance inference is deferred pending evidence;","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0323-C09",1330,1361,"do not fabricate probabilities.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C01",0,233,"Counterparty-attractiveness filter default (confirmed): Do NOT automatically reject or prune a legally feasible proposed trade simply because the other participant has negative delta V(R) or an unfavorable projected-point comparison.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C02",234,334,"By default, evaluate trade potential independently of the likelihood that an offer will be accepted;","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C03",335,397,"show both participants' delta V(R) as informative diagnostics.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C04",398,615,"Users may explicitly enable a configurable minimum counterparty delta V(R), nonnegative partner-benefit requirement or corresponding sort/filter, either during candidate screening or while exploring simulated results.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C05",616,803,"Such optional sellability assumptions must be disclosed, must never be confused with league legality, and must not alter the conditional full-league Monte Carlo results for a transaction.","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C06",804,872,"Maintain visibility of asymmetric trades when those filters are off;","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0325-C07",873,929,"real managers can have preferences not captured by V(R).","trade",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C01",0,367,"Automatic final-state equivalence and simulation reuse (confirmed): AFTER applying all explicit transactions, vacancy-event-prioritized roster completion, and final legality checks, construct a deterministic canonical fingerprint of the COMPLETE simulation-relevant starting league state, not merely the requesting manager's roster or the original traded player list.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C02",368,674,"Include all teams' player ownership/rosters and other effective state inputs that could change future league simulation (such as current shared unrostered pool, required roster/eligibility settings, standings/waiver state, league rule configuration and the exact pinned input snapshot/model configuration).","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C03",675,874,"Two distinct legal transaction paths that produce truly identical fingerprints MUST map to the SAME scenario evaluation ID and reuse the SAME Monte Carlo result, path counts, CIs and per-team deltas;","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C04",875,973,"do not independently simulate such paths or rely on same random seed alone to approximately match.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C05",974,1147,"Preserve all original trade-chain descriptions, execution/acceptability diagnostics and path-specific metadata as separate records linked many-to-one to the evaluated state.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C06",1148,1312,"Equivalence is assessed only after completion: differing vacancy priorities or drops may yield different final rosters even if the explicit trade ownership matches.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C07",1313,1522,"Canonical keys must use stable IDs, order-independent sorting where appropriate, exact model-relevant values (no lossy rounding), and version/snapshot scoping so different settings are never mistakenly merged.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C08",1523,1635,"A fingerprint collision or inconsistent state-to-result linkage is an invariant violation that must fail loudly.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C09",1636,1731,"Reuse evaluations only inside the relevant current search/run or approved checkpoint lifecycle;","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C10",1732,1802,"this does not imply retaining stale results across projection updates.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C11",1803,1912,"Treat this as a mandatory exact optimization compatible with exhaustive enumeration, never candidate pruning.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0327-C12",1913,2115,"Test that equivalent paths yield byte-for-byte identical displayed league-wide probabilities and confidence intervals and that genuinely different simulation-relevant states are not accidentally merged.","state_identity",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0329-C01",0,258,"Execution scheduling: efficiency without enumeration-order bias (confirmed): Permit overlapping candidate generation, roster completion/screening, and early paired Monte Carlo evaluation using bounded independent worker queues when benchmarks show a benefit;","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0329-C02",259,300,"retain a sequential reference/debug mode.","search",null,null],
    ["D8-MS-L0329-C03",301,547,"Processing order, batch size, worker count, candidate IDs, and CPU scheduling MUST NOT determine which legal candidates qualify, which canonical final states are deemed equal, or their simulation results/uncertainty for the same prescribed paths.","search",null,null],

    "S060": "12.1 Milestone sequence and status",
    "S061": "M0 — ESPN feasibility and historical-data audit \u005bCOMPLETE\u005d. Diagnostic scripts, documented actual API/endpoint coverage, historical projection provenance, complete league settings/waiver/bracket inventory, data dictionary, known gaps, and M1 handoff. PASS: each critical field is verified or explicitly addressed with a defensible path; material gaps and uncertainty are documented. M1 recommendation: GO WITH EXPLICIT UNRESOLVED METADATA.",
    "S062": "M1 — Canonical snapshots and validation \u005bCOMPLETE\u005d. ESPN adapter, standardized league/roster/player-week state, immutable staged and validated refresh, authoritative SQLite storage, deterministic quality reporting, and sanitized snapshot-management CLI. PASS: deterministic snapshot round-trip and selection, no data corruption on failed refresh or read-only inspection, complete identifiable league state and usable future inputs.",
    "S063": "M2 — Structurally complete full-season simulator \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M2.1–M2.6 implement exact deterministic lineup, regular-season, transaction, valuation, complete-cycle, postseason and full-season mechanics plus an explicitly provisional repeated-season runner. PASS: complete paths are legal and yield coherent championship/placement outcomes; known ESPN settings are honored; unsupported capabilities fail closed; provisional models remain labeled.",
    "S064": "M3 — Calibrated probabilistic and efficient baseline \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M3.1's evidence-preserving research dataset, M3.2's temporally held-out candidate evaluator/private evidence workflow, M3.3's explicitly provisional empirical draw model, M3.4's simultaneous league-wide precision layer, M3.5's bounded reproducible multiprocessing path, and M3.6's runtime profiles/progressive recovery are accepted. PASS: reasonable calibration evidence or explicit limitations, interval/convergence tests, reproducible multiprocessing/resume, representative throughput measurements.",
    "S065": "M4 — Manual generalized scenario evaluator \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. Explicit multi-team roster changes, protected pins, deterministic capacity drops then round-robin refills, full legal states, unified replacement-adjusted roster utility, paired baseline comparison and churn diagnostics. The implementation fingerprints the alternate initial state, verifies matched score evidence path by path, reports family-wise paired-difference uncertainty separately from standalone probabilities, and explains before/after projected optimal starters, bench, reserve, vacancies, and lineup totals for every team and remaining week. PASS evidence is recorded in `docs/MANUAL_SCENARIOS.md` and the roadmap.",
    "S066": "M5 — Automated actionable decision search \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M5.1–M5.8 provide exhaustive trade candidates and optional V(R) screening, canonical completed-state identity and shared evaluation, statistically guarded progressive Monte Carlo evaluation, standalone acquisitions, multi-trade chains, unified combined-action search, and bounded search orchestration with resource controls, indexed results, and exports. PASS EVIDENCE: every detailed M5 slice below is complete and accepted; recommendations preserve explicit coverage, legality, provenance, uncertainty, and resource-limit status.",
    "S067": "M6 — Application backend and validation \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M6.1–M6.4 provide API 1.0 contracts, canonical player/roster/schedule joins, bounded synchronous/background execution, retained result queries, parity/security/performance validation, local setup, operations, troubleshooting, and the explicit M7 data-readiness handoff. PASS: critical local workflows are reproducible, correct, operationally bounded, and ready for dashboard integration without duplicating analytical logic.",
    "S068": "Post-V1 research backlog — Joint player/game correlations: after the independent baseline is established, investigate same-team and opponent dependence (including QB–receiver stacks), common game-script effects, and across-week player-state persistence. Require defensible joint ESPN-era actuals, stable covariance/factor calibration, efficient multivariate simulation and measured effects on championship probability or decision quality; do not include correlated score draws in V1.",
    "S069": "Post-V1 research backlog — Player-specific volatility and bias: evaluate regularized, data-sufficient player-level departures from shared position/projection-level distributions only after M3 calibration and sufficient as-of history have been collected. Compare temporally held-out calibration and resulting decision quality, with hierarchical shrinkage/fallback to group estimates; do not include player-specific residual parameters in V1 or presume they improve outcomes. Also revisit forecast-horizon variance only when genuine earlier as-of snapshots exist.",
    "S070": "M7 — Analytics-first interactive application \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. The accepted shell presents retained baseline analytics, action-search discovery, the Trade Lab, and the Simulation Center with explicit background configuration, monitoring, cancellation, history, and result navigation. M8 remains deferred. All frontend data flows through accepted versioned backend contracts and follows \u005bUI_DESIGN_VISION.md\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/6f12f5fe5be49112546bf035b6d885b645898a86/docs/UI_DESIGN_VISION.md). PASS: principal workflows are accessible and responsive, and every numerical or legality claim reconciles with the engine.",
    "S071": "M8 — Local V1 release \u005bIN PROGRESS — M8.4 REVIEW PENDING\u005d. Reproducible installation, loopback startup, immutable ESPN refresh, end-to-end validation, and runtime/recovery certification are accepted. The consolidated security, limitations, documentation, and release-readiness audit is implemented for independent review. PASS: a clean local installation supports ESPN refresh → season outlook → action analysis → result exploration without notebooks or spreadsheets.",
    "S072": "12.1A Detailed milestone work packages and verification gates",
    "S073": "M0 — ESPN data and feasibility audit (first priority; discovery, not modeling)",
    "S074": "M1 — Versioned canonical snapshots and data contracts",
    "S075": "M2 — Complete deterministic season-path reference simulator",

    "S089": "M2 — Structurally complete full-season simulator \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M2.1–M2.6 provide deterministic lineup, matchup, transaction, valuation, cycle, postseason and complete-season mechanics plus explicitly provisional repeated-season execution. PASS: every complete path is legal and yields coherent championship/placement outcomes; known ESPN settings are honored; provisional models remain labeled.",
    "S090": "M3 — Calibrated probabilistic and efficient baseline \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M3.1's evidence-preserving research dataset, M3.2's temporally held-out comparison/private evidence workflow, M3.3's provisional draw model, M3.4's simultaneous league-wide precision layer, M3.5's bounded multiprocessing path, and M3.6's runtime profiles/durable recovery are accepted. PASS: reasonable calibration evidence or explicit limitations, interval/convergence tests, reproducible multiprocessing/resume, representative throughput measurements.",
    "S091": "M4 — Manual generalized scenario evaluator \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. Explicit multi-team roster changes, protected pins, deterministic capacity drops then round-robin refills, full legal states, unified replacement-adjusted roster utility, paired baseline comparison, lineup/roster explanations, and churn diagnostics. PASS EVIDENCE: invalid scenarios are rejected, no ownership duplication is possible, every configured team's championship/playoff/placement delta has paired uncertainty, matched sequential/parallel paths reconcile, and the persisted-snapshot CLI workflow is reproducible offline. Accepted after independent review. See `MANUAL_SCENARIOS.md`.",
    "S092": "M6 — Application backend and validation \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. M6.1–M6.4 provide stable API contracts, canonical metadata joins, bounded execution, lifecycle/results, parity/security/performance evidence, setup, operations, and frontend data readiness. PASS: critical application workflows are reproducible, correct, operationally bounded, and ready for dashboard integration without frontend analytical reconstruction.",
    "S093": "M7 — Analytics-first interactive application \u005bCOMPLETE AND ACCEPTED\u005d. The accepted analytical workspaces include the League Overview, Opportunity Explorer, Trade Lab, and Simulation Center with explicit run configuration, source-backed monitoring, cancellation, retained history, and result navigation through API 1.0. M8 remains staged, guided by the \u005bpremium football analytics design vision\u005d(https://github.com/tdkelley2001/fantasy_football/blob/6f12f5fe5be49112546bf035b6d885b645898a86/docs/UI_DESIGN_VISION.md). PASS: principal workflows are navigable without low-level Python commands and every analytical claim reconciles with the backend.",
    "S094": "M8 — Local V1 release \u005bIN PROGRESS — M8.4 REVIEW PENDING\u005d. Installation, browser refresh, end-to-end live validation, and runtime/recovery certification are accepted. The final consolidated release audit is implemented for independent review; it does not declare V1 released. PASS: a clean local installation supports ESPN refresh → season outlook → action analysis → result exploration without notebooks or spreadsheets."

## D8.2 transfer verification

**Implemented for independent review, not an authority switch.** Accepted D8.1 revision is `2c9c4be560bc3cd1f5839ec1ead54027194b6a0c`. The entire original crosswalk above, its 79 assessments/overrides, 407 groups, 2,093 source IDs/text spans and 33 findings remain unchanged. This separate layer records actual permanent text and remaining gates, without reclassifying the accepted inventory or repeating its quotations. MASTER_SPEC/ROADMAP and historical/plan sources remain; WR-002 stays open and V1 is not released.

Each record below names the clause, its **effective** D8.1 classification/implementation/disposition, an actual destination group, transfer status, remaining-gate reference and authority conflict if any. Shared groups give exact permanent anchors, current section hashes/excerpts, acceptance constraints and source/test references. An anchor or symbol alone is not the coverage claim: the corresponding requirement text and linked cross-domain constraints were reviewed, with material gaps/incorrect adjacent implementation description recorded in `coverage_corrections`. Tests check structural traceability and selected precise acceptance text, not semantic completeness, software correctness or scientific/release approval. Independent disposition is pending at every level.

### Historical evidence and retirement readiness

All **33 historical findings** have separate permanent destinations/statuses and source hashes below. This preserves R1 maintenance/compatibility gates, R23/WR-022, R25/R26 source/asset risks, ordered sequence hashing, reusable pool seed identity, M8 source/manual-consolation evidence, exact-cache/reference equivalence, private data, logical/physical resource distinctions, quantitative p95/admission/reference/orphan/restart criteria and independent M8.4/P0/configuration signoff. Old test/vulnerability/timing totals are not current acceptance. No historical asset, example, benchmark or source is deleted.

**Retirement readiness: blocked pending independent D8.2 acceptance and the explicit C13 authority disposition.** Implementation defects/scientific/release work do not disappear or become source-retirement permissions. After accepted transfer, a separately scoped D8.3 must re-scan all code/test/plain/Markdown/anchor/evidence consumers and hold unresolved sources, preserve required oracles/benchmarks/research examples and private data, and review any final authority-link switch. No blanket deletion is authorized by this layer.

    "projection": {"primary_destination":"docs/DATA.md#projection-contract","supporting_destinations":[],"preserved_acceptance":"Canonical evidence cannot be overwritten/misattributed to ESPN; dynamic source precedence and coverage remain validated.","coverage_scope":"Raw missing, explicit zero, finite signed values and effective policy zero retain separate class/source fields; lineup availability uses positive effective projection.","evidence":[{"destination":"docs/DATA.md#projection-contract","section_sha256":"c2cbed42116f1362c102c31db7b9d250251a2b8cb0489d6fbffb3a5e5c73a6fd","baseline_section_sha256":"c2cbed42116f1362c102c31db7b9d250251a2b8cb0489d6fbffb3a5e5c73a6fd","excerpts":["Historical provenance: the 15 October 2026 M0.3 follow-up used current-week kona_player_info for the configured 2026 league, week 6: pages 250/250/250/250/52, 1,052 distinct IDs. Absence of a matching record was classified as missing; a matching appliedTotal=0 was explicit zero. The library's defaulted appliedTotal could not preserve that distinction. Current wrapper status/onTeamId supplied ownership, proTeamId=0 meant no association, explicit byeWeek was cross-checked with proGamesByScoringPeriod; injuryStatus/injured/active were descriptive, not future-health permission. The sample had 657 present values (286 zeros, 371 positive), 395 missing and no observed negative projection. Of the missing records, 394 were unrostered (384 free agents, 10 waivers), one rostered; 297 lacked NFL association, 98 had one, and seven were on bye. All 395 exposed active=true; 54 were NFL-assigned, non-bye and ACTIVE. These overlapping dimensions are not additive absence explanations or universal rates. ## C13 proposed disposition

**Pending independent review.** This additive extension to D8.2 preserves the complete accepted D8.1/D8.2 document above unchanged, including its blocked C13 decisions and then-pending review evidence. D8.2 was independently accepted at `38b6f78881e872dd07ff1fc16f6a9785e77d59c5`; this new interpretation was not accepted at that revision. The original restriction applies to ephemeral engine search context; accepted M6.2/M7 are proposed as the narrow successor for separately persisted bounded application history, not permission for an unbounded archive or silent reuse.

[Application policy and lifecycle matrix](../APPLICATION_SERVICE.md#c13-proposed-retention-authority), [engine ownership](../UNIFIED_ACTION_SEARCH.md#c13-proposed-engine-lifecycle) and [decision gate](../BACKLOG.md#c13-proposed-authority-decision) distinguish current implementation, WR-026/021 gaps and the proposed authority choice. No current transfer row is retroactively reclassified; affected retirement stays blocked until independent acceptance. No production migration, new retention default or D8.3 authority switch is performed.
